articles.title: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
articles.abstract: As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf{\hivemem}, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion with \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90\% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.
articles.titleCn: HiVe-Mem：为多模态智能体交错水平内存扩展和垂直证据组合
articles.abstractCn: 随着多模态智能体积累越来越长的交互历史，有效检索和利用过去信息对于长期交互至关重要。现有的记忆系统通常依赖于对压缩记忆的语义检索，并暴露预定义的表示形式，这可能会遗漏相关记忆并忽略查询中异构证据需求。我们引入了 \textbf{\hivemem}，一个多模态记忆框架，它将 \textbf{\textsc{H}}orizontal Memory Expansion 与 \textbf{\textsc{V}}ertical Evidence Composition 交错结合。在水平记忆扩展方面，\hivemem 使用文本和视觉锚点将记忆片段组织成关系图，通过相关邻居扩展语义检索的种子以恢复互补信息。在垂直证据组合方面，每个检索的记忆保留多种证据形式，包括紧凑摘要、标题、基于视觉的视图、原始图像和交互历史。一个轻量级的可训练选择器独立地为每个检索的记忆组合证据子集，实现查询自适应的多模态信息利用。这种二维设计共同扩展了记忆覆盖范围，并适应了单个记忆贡献的证据。在三个多模态记忆基准测试中的实验表明，\hivemem 在基础模型上始终提高任务性能，同时与最有效的竞争多模态基线相比，将标记消耗减少了约 90%。

articles.title: Is Persona Generalization Predictable?
articles.abstract: Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others -- for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising "on-the-line" phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This "on-the-line" phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.
articles.titleCn: 人格泛化是否可预测？
articles.abstractCn: 在针对某一领域微调语言模型时，如果出现了跨领域的行为变化——例如在涌现性错位中观察到的广泛不安全行为——就会发生人格泛化。我们在人格泛化中发现了一个令人惊讶的“在线”现象：针对不同微调超参数，领域内和领域外的人格率近似遵循概率线性关系，而具体的概率线性关系甚至在不同模型家族和模型规模之间也惊人地共享，包括Qwen和Llama。那些不改变可训练参数集的训练选择，如学习率、权重衰减和训练时长，主要使模型沿着同一条线移动，通过削弱领域内学习来减少迁移。然而，改变微调的层可以改变斜率。对于不安全行为，仅微调后期层会产生较浅的斜率，在保持强领域内学习的同时减少领域外错位。这种“在线”现象在定量框架内统一了对人格泛化意外、孤立观察的预测和控制行为迁移。

articles.title: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
articles.abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.
articles.titleCn: WorkflowArena：基于LLM的多智能体系统中可执行工作流编排的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理正越来越多地被部署为多代理系统，而不是作为在单一情境内独立运行的模型。最近的代理应用允许模型实例化工作代理并编写协调它们的可执行工作流，将系统结构的设汁从开发者在运行时转移到了模型。因此，这种组织的质量构成了一个独特的功能，但现有的基准要么衡量端到端的任务完成情况，要么评估预先指定的结构下的协调情况。我们将这一功能形式化为工作流编排，并介绍了WorkflowArena，这是一个涵盖8个专业领域的145个长期任务基准，从软件工程和形式数学到法律分析和3D生产。每个任务都指定一个初始工作空间和一个由相互依赖的组件组成的集成交付成果，并由隐藏的验证器进行评估。代理自主决定是否以及如何委派，并且所有委派都被记录下来，从而能够联合评估交付成果的质量和底层工作的组织。九个模型的实验表明，没有单一的配置在所有领域都表现最佳，并且系统表现出不同的委派策略：在高努力程度下，Claude Code中的Claude模型调用工作流的频率较低，但使用更大的工作代理组，而Codex中的GPT模型以较小的单元更频繁地委派。当执行模型在具有挑战性的任务子集上保持固定时，Claude Opus 5.5编写的工作流显著改善了较弱的执行者，表明工作流组织本身是任务性能的一个可衡量的决定因素。

articles.title: How Well Does AI Peer Review Work? A Benchmark Built from 100 Planted Errors
articles.abstract: One hundred known errors were planted into 10 open-access psychology papers, and the modified papers were then run through frontier models and two commercial AI review tools. The best single system caught 71 of the 100 errors, while the worst caught 30. Pooling every system's output caught 93. Models are only partly correlated in the errors they find, which makes ensembling a big lever for finding issues in papers. Seven errors could not be caught by any system, and all seven were omissions: information deleted from a paper rather than mistakes inserted into it. Refine.ink contributes more unique catches than any other single system, though it is expensive on a per-error basis. False positives were not measured, and how this error distribution compares to the distribution of errors in real papers remains unknown. The papers, errors, model outputs, and full experiment log are public, so that others can build on this toward a comprehensive evaluation benchmark across disciplines.
articles.comment: 5 pages; accepted at Cognitive Security for Human-AI Systems (CogSec 2026), a non-archival workshop at ACM HCOMP / CI 2026
articles.titleCn: 人工智能同行评审效果如何？基于100个植入性错误构建的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 在一篇开放获取的心理学论文中植入了100个已知错误，然后将修改后的论文输入到前沿模型和两个商业AI审稿工具中。最佳单一系统检测出了71个错误，而最差系统仅检测出30个。综合所有系统的输出则能检测出93个错误。模型在检测到的错误上只有部分相关性，这使得集成学习方法成为发现论文问题的重要手段。有7个错误无法被任何系统检测到，而且这7个错误都是遗漏：即论文中被删除的信息，而非插入的错误。Refine.ink比其他任何单一系统贡献了更多独特的检测结果，尽管它在每个错误检测上的成本较高。未测量误报率，且目前尚不清楚这种错误分布与真实论文中的错误分布有何比较。论文、错误、模型输出和完整实验日志均已公开，以便其他人可以在此基础上构建跨学科的综合性评估基准。

articles.title: Curbside Chatbots: Auditing the Mental Health Interventions Large Language Models Recommend to Clinicians, Caregivers, and Patients
articles.abstract: Users are asking language models mental health questions and are receiving answers. We audited what 41 language models recommend to users when the same clinical information reaches them from three footings: a clinician describing a patient, a caregiver describing a loved one, or a person describing themselves. Across 19 case vignettes and five questions, we collected 35,055 free-text responses, extracted every intervention named with a validated judge, and had 29 models rate the full option lists on a seven-point Likert scale for the same cases. Models largely recommend what they rate well, with recommendation behavior differing by footing, and many models offering clinicians a consultation-style response and lay users hedged, simplified advice. When asked about recommendations for a specific intervention type, models more often named options they themselves rated below zero as initial choices, usually with conditions attached. We will release the instrument, code, and full corpus on publication as a living audit.
articles.comment: 100 pages: 30 page main text and references, 70 page appendix. 7 figures, 2 tables. Results explorer: https://mindbench.ai/audits/interventions
articles.titleCn: 路边聊天机器人：审计大型语言模型向临床医生、护理人员和患者推荐的心理健康干预措施
articles.abstractCn: 用户正在向语言模型提出心理健康问题并接收答案。我们审计了当相同的临床信息以三种立场呈现给41种语言模型时，它们向用户推荐的内容：一位临床医生描述患者、一位照护者描述所爱的人，或一个人描述自己。在19个案例摘要和五个问题中，我们收集了35,055条自由文本回复，通过经过验证的裁判提取了所有提及的干预措施，并有29种模型对相同案例的完整选项列表进行七点李克特量表评分。模型主要推荐它们评价较高的选项，推荐行为因立场而异，许多模型向临床医生提供咨询式回复，而向普通用户提供保留、简化的建议。当被问及特定干预类型的推荐时，模型更倾向于将它们自己评价低于零的选项作为初始选择，通常附带条件。我们将随着发表发布该工具、代码和完整语料库，作为一个持续进行的审计。

articles.title: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning
articles.abstract: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型作为开放世界自动化机器学习的通用搜索器
articles.abstractCn: 开发有效的机器学习模型需要复杂的手动调优，而当前的自动化机器学习（AutoML）框架仍然具有领域特定性，并将模型架构、训练超参数和数据比例优化相互隔离。在此，我们通过提出一种通用的、基于大型语言模型（LLM）的AutoML框架来弥合这一差距，该框架首次联合优化这些配置，而无需特定任务的微调。我们提出了NCode，一种统一的数值编码方案，将各种AutoML设计选择转化为通用的离散序列，并有效地将优化过程重新定义为统一的排序任务。该基于LLM的搜索器仅通过有限的单领域视觉任务的优化轨迹进行训练，展示了令人印象深刻的跨任务、跨模态和联合搜索空间优化的泛化能力，在图像分类、图像分割、说话人验证和文本到图像基准测试中均取得了最先进的性能。关键在于，它在十亿参数扩散变压器的规模化训练和联合优化中表现出卓越的可扩展性，仅需896 GPU天即可达到0.91的最先进GenEval分数。通过利用强化学习来植入思维链推理，我们提供了一种系统的方法来解释基于LLM的搜索器的内部决策机制，揭示其优化策略从早期的多样性驱动探索转变为后期的锚点利用。我们提出的框架为通用开放世界机器学习优化提供了一条可扩展、可泛化和可解释的途径。

articles.title: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
articles.abstract: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT
articles.titleCn: 通过鲁棒词级重加权进行偏好优化
articles.abstractCn: 偏好优化已成为使大型语言模型与人类价值观保持一致的核心方法，但其效果严重依赖于偏好标注的质量。在实际应用中，由于标注错误和模糊性，偏好数据往往存在噪声。现有的鲁棒偏好优化方法主要在序列级别操作，隐式地将整个响应视为完全正确或完全错误。然而，被拒绝的响应可能仍包含有信息量的推理步骤，而优先的响应可能包含细微错误。在这项工作中，我们提出了基于鲁棒标记级别重加权进行偏好优化的方法（PORT），这是一个在噪声偏好下进行鲁棒对齐的细粒度框架。PORT使用标记对数概率的经验累积分布函数（CDF）进行标记级别重加权，产生一个仅在前向传递中即可计算的梯度范数惩罚的有效代理，该代理能够选择性地抑制受损标记，而无需额外的反向传递计算。我们提供了理论分析，表明PORT通过最小化偏差项的上界来减少噪声偏好标签产生的梯度偏差。在多种噪声设置下的大量实验表明，PORT始终提高鲁棒性，并优于现有的序列级别基线。代码可在https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT获取。

articles.title: The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people seek and consume information, including accounts that differ across languages and regions, especially on contested topics. Supporting diverse information seeking requires models to help users navigate competing narratives across languages and information streams. We define six capabilities necessary for diverse multilingual information seeking: three foundational capabilities for narrative inclusion, narrative exclusion, and missing narrative identification; and three higher-level capabilities for presenting diverse narratives, preserving narrative coverage under confirmatory queries, and maintaining information parity across languages. To guide the development of those information seeking capabilities, we introduce \textsc{NarrativeBench}, a benchmark comprising 1,333 news articles in 23 publication languages across 23 contested topics and 460 Reddit-grounded queries. Evaluating 14 LLMs across 24 query languages, we find that current models lack the capabilities needed to reliably navigate diverse narratives, limiting users' control over the perspectives they receive and leaving substantial gaps in exposure to competing accounts even when diversity is explicitly requested. Information access also differs across query framings and languages, risking echo chambers, linguistic filter bubbles, and information disparities that weaken the common ground needed for democratic discourse. \textsc{NarrativeBench} provides a foundation for developing information systems that give users across languages and regions agency to navigate diverse narratives.
articles.titleCn: 叙事鸿沟：大型语言模型能否帮助我们跨越不同语言的叙事？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）日益影响着人们获取和消费信息的方式，包括跨语言和地区的不同观点，尤其是在有争议的话题上。支持多样化的信息获取需要模型帮助用户在不同语言和信息流之间进行导航。我们定义了六项支持多样化多语言信息获取的必要能力：三项基础能力，即叙事包容、叙事排除和缺失叙事识别；以及三项高级能力，即呈现多样化叙事、在确认性查询下保持叙事覆盖度以及维护跨语言的信息平衡。为了指导这些信息获取能力的发展，我们引入了\textsc{NarrativeBench}，这是一个基准，包含23种出版物语言、23个有争议话题中的1333篇新闻报道和460个基于Reddit的查询。在24种查询语言中评估14个LLM后，我们发现当前模型缺乏可靠导航多样化叙事的能力，限制了用户对所接收观点的控制，即使在明确要求多样化时，也导致对竞争性观点的接触存在巨大差距。信息获取方式也因查询框架和语言的不同而存在差异，这可能导致回声室效应、语言过滤气泡和信息不平等，从而削弱民主讨论所需的基本共识。 \textsc{NarrativeBench}为开发能够赋予不同语言和地区的用户导航多样化叙事能力的信息系统奠定了基础。

articles.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.
articles.titleCn: 面向多轮临床智能体的安全强化学习：密集奖励优于结果奖励
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励的强化学习越来越多地用于提升语言模型的推理能力，但其对序列决策程序的影响仍缺乏深入理解。我们在临床多轮智能体中研究这一问题，这类智能体必须决定请求何种信息、何时停止收集证据以及采取何种行动。我们引入了三个受控环境：药物补发分诊、急性诊断流程和剂量滴定，每个环境均包含隐藏的临床状态、查询成本、精确自适应预言机和确定性结果验证器。在这些任务中，仅基于结果的相对策略优化常能提升总奖励，但会产生不理想的程序，包括过早决策、单轮崩溃以及对罕见高风险案例的处理失败。在诊断任务中，相较于仅基于结果的强化学习，将密集信用分配给减少不确定性的问题，在三个训练种子上均提升了保留集价值和对中等风险案例的支持，且未出现仅基于结果训练时的高风险种子崩溃现象。将探索与利用分离进一步提升了高风险支持的最佳检查点，但代价是低风险案例过度收集信息。额外实验表明，过程信用的最优强度取决于任务；在已完成精心收集的监督预训练后，强化学习通过削减问题提升了总奖励，但损害了高风险性能；强化学习并不能可靠地修复源自有偏监督数据的罕见行为偏差。因此，可验证的最终结果不足以训练可靠的多元轮智能体：奖励设计必须考虑得出答案所使用的程序，评估必须区分自适应信息收集与奖励利用的捷径。

articles.title: A local language model layered with rule-based and neural detectors for clinical text de-identification: an open-source toolkit and evaluation
articles.abstract: Objectives: To measure whether a locally hosted large language model (LLM), stacked with deterministic and clinical named-entity recognition (NER) detectors, finds more protected health information (PHI) than open tools, and at what precision. Materials and Methods: DeidSharp, an open-source .NET toolkit, combines the findings of pluggable detectors (patterns, a clinical NER model, a local 26B mixture-of-experts LLM) and fails closed on any detector error. Configurations fixed on tuning halves were compared, under a prespecified protocol, with deid, Philter, the Stanford/Penn de-identifier, OpenAI Privacy Filter and GLiNER on reporting halves of PhysioNet's nursing notes (889 spans) and semi-synthetic MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries (29,023 spans), and on synthetic ASQ-PHI queries, with paired patient-level bootstrap intervals. Results: In the nursing notes, against Stanford/Penn, the recall-first stack found 98.9% of PHI (+2.8, 95% CI 1.4 to 4.4) at 9.3 points lower precision; the precision-first stack, without NER, found 96.5%, matching Stanford/Penn, at 19.6 points higher precision (83.2%). In the discharge summaries, both stacks led Stanford/Penn by more than 20 points (recall-first 95.3%, +21.5, 20.5 to 22.4), almost entirely on generated untyped names; on typed labels all three exceeded 99%. All four prespecified comparisons held. No configuration beat deid significantly on its home corpus; Philter found more discharge-summary spans than the recall-first stack at 23 points lower precision. Discussion: The LLM was the main detector and NER added place names; asked to verify its own findings, the LLM discarded a quarter of true PHI. Conclusion: A local LLM layered with deterministic detectors offers recall-first and precision-first operating points without sending text off-site.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; supplementary material as ancillary file. Code: https://github.com/valburkin/DeidSharp
articles.titleCn: 基于规则和神经检测器层叠的本地语言模型用于临床文本去识别：一个开源工具包和评估
articles.abstractCn: 目标：测量一个本地部署的大型语言模型（LLM），结合确定性临床命名实体识别（NER）检测器，是否比公开工具发现更多受保护健康信息（PHI），以及其精确度。材料与方法：DeidSharp是一个开源的.NET工具包，它结合了可插拔检测器（模式、临床NER模型、本地26B专家混合LLM）的结果，并在任何检测器错误时关闭。在调优半部分固定的配置下，根据预定的协议，与deid、Philter、斯坦福/宾夕法尼亚去识别器、OpenAI隐私过滤器以及GLiNER在PhysioNet的护理记录（889个跨度）和半合成MIMIC-IV-Note出院记录（29,023个跨度）的报告半部分，以及合成ASQ-PHI查询上进行了比较，并使用配对患者级引导区间。结果：在护理记录中，针对斯坦福/宾夕法尼亚，召回优先堆栈在9.3点更低的精确度下发现了98.9%的PHI（+2.8，95% CI 1.4至4.4）；精确优先堆栈不包含NER，发现了96.5%，与斯坦福/宾夕法尼亚相当，但精确度高出19.6点（83.2%）。在出院记录中，两个堆栈都比斯坦福/宾夕法尼亚高出20多分（召回优先95.3%，+21.5，20.5至22.4），几乎完全基于生成的无类型名称；在类型标签上，所有三个都超过99%。所有四个预定的比较均成立。没有配置在其本地语料库上显著优于deid；Philter在精确度低23分的情况下发现了更多出院记录跨度。讨论：LLM是主要的检测器，NER增加了地名；要求验证其自身发现时，LLM舍弃了四分之一的真实PHI。结论：本地LLM与确定性检测器结合，无需将文本传输到异地，即可提供召回优先和精确优先的操作点。

articles.title: A Lattice-Based HMM Approach to Aruz Scansion of Ottoman Poetry
articles.abstract: Ottoman Divan poetry is composed in aruz, a quantitative meter based on the weights of syllables. The meter is sensitive to specific characters recorded in the original writing in the Arabic script. This work is concerned with automatic meter finding and scansion alignment for Ottoman Divan poetry, especially on modern Turkish spelling without the special diacritics that scholarly transliterations of Ottoman preserve. We define two tasks on this input, first identifying the meter used in the poem, and second aligning the meter's weights with the syllabification of the poem, identifying the flaws and freedoms the poet has taken along the way. We build a corpus of 52,000 lines split by poet, with scansion annotations for 500 test lines, and a robustness benchmark generated at the deviation rates measured on real web and OCR copies. Our model is a hidden Markov model over the positions of each meter, decoded over a lattice of every candidate path, and trained by EM from the printed meter, without scansion labels. On a held-out set it scans 77.6% of the test lines fully correctly, against 26.8% for the available rule-based scanner, 55.0% for a neural tagger trained with the same supervision and 63.6% for Claude Opus 5.5 few-shot. The code is open-sourced and the tool is released on the web.
articles.comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/MehmetETiryaki/aruz-paper. Web tool: https://mehmetemretiryaki.com/aruz
articles.titleCn: 基于格网的奥斯曼诗歌阿鲁兹扫描方法
articles.abstractCn: 奥斯曼迪万诗歌采用基于音节重量的定量韵律体系——阿鲁兹韵律。这种韵律体系对阿拉伯文字母原稿中记录的特定字符敏感。本研究专注于奥斯曼迪万诗歌的自动韵律识别与格律对齐，尤其针对现代土耳其拼写，不包含奥斯曼学术转写保留的特殊变音符号。我们在这项输入中定义了两个任务：首先识别诗歌中使用的韵律，其次将韵律的重量与诗歌的音节划分对齐，识别诗人创作过程中的瑕疵与自由度。我们构建了一个包含52,000行、按诗人划分的语料库，其中500行有格律标注，并生成了一个基于真实网络和OCR副本偏差率生成的鲁棒性基准。我们的模型是一个关于每个韵律位置的隐马尔可夫模型，在所有候选路径的格律网络上进行解码，并通过打印韵律（无格律标注）进行EM训练。在保留集上，该模型完全正确地格律分析77.6%的测试行，而现有的基于规则的扫描器仅为26.8%，使用相同监督训练的神经网络标记器为55.0%，Claude Opus 5.5少样本为63.6%。代码已开源，工具已发布于网络。

articles.title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
articles.abstract: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Presented as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS). Code and data: https://github.com/hanktang-research/TrialDesignBench
articles.titleCn: 试验设计基准：基于临床知识对I期试验设计语言模型进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能被广泛应用于临床试验的各个环节。然而，在试验的统计设计选择方面——这一决定药物剂量如何在人体中测试和评估的关键步骤——几乎没有取得人工智能的进展。鉴于大型语言模型在生物医学知识和统计推理方面的优势，它们似乎与这一任务非常契合。尽管如此，目前还没有适当的方法来评估这些能力，因为最近的监管和方法学转变，尤其是美国食品药品监督管理局的“优化计划”（Project Optimus），重新定义了什么是合理的试验设计，并使许多先前的设计过时。为了为人工智能辅助试验设计奠定基础，我们引入了TrialDesignBench，这是一个包含617个I期/I/II期肿瘤学剂量探索试验的基准，每个试验都配有一个由专家验证的参考设计，该设计与最新的美国食品药品监督管理局监管倡议保持一致。这个参考标准是通过形式化专家设计过程产生的。我们评估了五种前沿的大型语言模型，但它们中没有一种能达到参考标准。我们的消融实验将这种性能差距归因于两个主要原因：从试验来源中推断潜在的、未记录的设计决定因素（提供这些因素使类别平衡准确率提高了0.22），以及结构化决策树推理（+0.24）。TrialDesignBench提供了一个可重复的、当代标准的客观目标，用于评估和改进人工智能辅助的试验设计。

articles.title: How Far Does Second-Order Linear Response Predict Quantization Mismatch? Pre-Registered Measurements on Five Language Models
articles.abstract: Serving systems choose a weight format for each model and deployment. A low-cost screen predicts the resulting KL divergence from the unquantized model's Fisher information using $\tfrac12Δ^\top FΔ$, the expansion underlying Hessian-aware and second-order post-training quantizers. We assess the reliability of this screen in GPU batches with channel-wise int8, per-tensor fp8 and group-wise int4 on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Relative predictions hold across a 16-fold range of perturbation scales, int4 group sizes and rounding modes, while absolute predictions are heavy-tailed. A trimmed average brings 10 of 12 cells on Qwen3-4B and OLMo-2 within 15% of measured KL. The MoE model exhibits nonquadratic response at small perturbations, with int8 KL scaling as $α^{0.63}$. Computing per-sequence gradients in bf16 can cause fourfold prediction errors. We trace these errors to arithmetic in the lower half of the backward pass and eliminate them by using fp32 there. Batch-invariant kernels run at 0.55 times the throughput, while changes in reduction order introduce a floor of 0.17-0.22 nats per sequence. We build a screener with one streamed fp32 Fisher pass, trimmed tensor-block predictions with a band, a flag for aligned tensors and per-layer format allocation. On the unseen Mistral-7B-v0.3 family, all six predictions fall within the band, all three KL budgets are met, and vLLM throughput is predicted within 0.4%.
articles.titleCn: 二阶线性响应预测量化不匹配的程度？五款语言模型的预注册测量
articles.abstractCn: 服务系统为每个模型和部署选择权重格式。低成本屏幕使用$\tfrac12Δ^\top FΔ$从未量化模型的Fisher信息预测结果KL散度，这是Hessian感知和二阶后训练量化器的基础展开。我们在GPU批次中评估了Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-4B、OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-32B和Qwen3-30B-A3B上按通道int8、每个张量fp8和按组int4的可靠性，相对预测在扰动尺度16倍范围内、int4组大小和舍入模式下均成立，而绝对预测呈现重尾分布。修剪平均使Qwen3-4B和OLMo-2的12个单元中的10个在测量KL的15%以内。在微小扰动下，MoE模型表现出非二次响应，int8 KL按$α^{0.63}$缩放。在bf16中计算每个序列梯度会导致四倍预测误差，我们将这些误差追溯到反向传播的下半部分运算，并通过在那里使用fp32消除了它们。不变批次内核的吞吐量降低到0.55倍，而约简顺序的变化引入了0.17-0.22 nats每个序列的地面值。我们构建了一个屏幕器，包含一个流式fp32 Fisher传递、带通修剪张量块预测、对齐张量的标志和每层格式分配。在未见过的Mistral-7B-v0.3系列上，所有六个预测都在带通内，所有三个KL预算均满足，vLLM吞吐量预测误差在0.4%以内。

articles.title: Adapting Small Language Models to Romanized Nepali: Tokenizer Fertility, Reference Likelihood, and Generation Metrics
articles.abstract: Romanized Nepali, Nepali written in Latin script, is common in digital communication but has no standard spelling and few resources, and it is unclear how reliably small open language models can be adapted to it. We adapt three 2-3B base models from different families, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Gemma-2-2B, with QLoRA on 9,000 instruction examples produced by deterministic transliteration of Nepali instruction data. Each model is trained with one shared recipe and three seeds and evaluated on 1,000 held-out examples with reference-overlap metrics, byte-normalized reference likelihood (bits per byte, BPB), and an output audit, against zero-shot baselines under two prompts. Fine-tuning raises chrF++ from 10-14 to 29.0-30.6 and lowers BPB from 2.23-2.41 to 0.78-0.84; most zero-shot outputs (54-92%) are English-like. Likelihood and overlap disagree on how far apart the models are. Llama-3.2-3B has the lowest BPB in every seed, 0.042 below Qwen2.5-3B (95% CI 0.039-0.046), yet the two cannot be separated on chrF++ (30.51 and 30.61) or BLEU, even with paired item-level tests. Gemma-2-2B, whose tokenizer splits Romanized Nepali words least (2.72 tokens per word), scores worst on every measure. Which model gains most over its zero-shot baseline depends on the zero-shot prompt. In a supplementary comparison with an identical tokenizer, Llama-3.1-8B lowers BPB by 0.053 (0.050-0.056) relative to Llama-3.2-3B, while chrF++ and BLEU rise by only 0.68 and 0.58 points. Lower fertility and higher reference likelihood therefore did not identify the model whose outputs were closest to the references.
articles.titleCn: 适配小型语言模型至罗马化尼泊尔语：分词器丰度、参考可能性及生成指标
articles.abstractCn: 罗马化尼泊尔语，即用拉丁字母书写的尼泊尔语，在数字通信中很常见，但没有标准的拼写方式，资源也较少，目前尚不清楚小型开放语言模型能否可靠地适应它。我们使用QLoRA技术，基于9000个由确定性转写生成的尼泊尔指令数据，对三个不同系列的2-3B基础模型——Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-3B和Gemma-2-2B——进行了适配。每个模型都使用一个共享的训练配方和三个种子进行训练，并在1000个保留示例上使用参考重叠指标、字节归一化参考似然度（每字节比特数，BPB）和输出审核进行评估，对比在两种提示下的零样本基线。微调后，chrF++从10-14提升至29.0-30.6，BPB从2.23-2.41降至0.78-0.84；大多数零样本输出（54-92%）类似英语。似然度和重叠度对模型的差异程度存在分歧。Llama-3.2-3B在所有种子中具有最低的BPB，比Qwen2.5-3B低0.042（95%置信区间为0.039-0.046），但在chrF++（30.51和30.61）或BLEU上无法区分，即使进行配对项目级测试。Gemma-2-2B的分词器对罗马化尼泊尔语单词的分割最少（每个单词2.72个标记），在所有指标上得分最差。哪个模型相对于其零样本基线提升最大，取决于零样本提示。在相同分词器的补充比较中，Llama-3.1-8B相对于Llama-3.2-3B降低了BPB（0.053，0.050-0.056），而chrF++和BLEU分别仅提升了0.68和0.58。因此，较低的生育率和较高的参考似然度并没有识别出输出最接近参考的模型。

articles.title: Type-logical grammars and formal languages
articles.abstract: We show that type-logical grammars with the standard rules for product, associativity, extraction and infixation have an NP-complete fixed recognition problem, adapting a construction for first-order linear logic from Pshenitsyn (2025), who already showed that grammars in first-order linear logic are closed under intersection and therefore not semilinear and not mildly context-sensitive. We strengthen these results and shown that grammars in first-order linear logic can simulate the quasi-linear grammars of Book \& Greibach (1970), the grammars recognised in non-deterministic linear time (NSPACE(n) or. NLIN). I argue that NLIN is an interesting class of formal languages as well, and a useful upper bound on the time complexity of formalisms used for natural language, just like LOGCFL is a useful upper bound on the space complexity. Taken together this means that first-order linear logic can be seen as the logic of non-deterministic linear-time string languages, graph languages and automata.
articles.titleCn: 类型逻辑语法和形式语言
articles.abstractCn: 我们证明了具有标准乘积、结合、提取和后置运算规则的类型逻辑文法具有NP完全的固定识别问题，这是基于Pshenitsyn（2025）对一阶线性逻辑构造的改进，Pshenitsyn已经证明一阶线性逻辑中的文法在交集下是封闭的，因此不是半线性的，也不是温和上下文敏感的。我们加强了这些结果，并表明一阶线性逻辑中的文法可以模拟Book & Greibach（1970）提出的拟线性文法，以及非确定性线性时间（NSPACE(n)或NLIN）中识别的文法。我认为NLIN也是一个有趣的正式语言类别，正如LOGCFL是空间复杂性的有用上界一样，它也是自然语言形式化所使用的时间复杂性的有用上界。综合来看，这意味着一阶线性逻辑可以被看作是非确定性线性时字符串语言、图语言和自动机的逻辑。

articles.title: Unmasking Four Knapsack Problems in the Traveling Thief Benchmark
articles.abstract: The traveling thief problem (TTP) asks a thief to choose a tour and a packing together, and the benchmark of 9,720 instances of Polyakovskiy et al. (2014) is the standard test set for comparing TTP heuristics. We show that four of these instances are not TTP instances at all. Their files give a renting rate of 0.00, so the tour has no effect on the objective and each instance reduces to a 0-1 knapsack problem. One of them belongs to the 60 categorized instances on which new methods are usually compared, and on it five of nine published methods report exactly the same value. The cause is the format of the files, which keep the renting rate with two decimals, while the rule of the generator gives a rate close to 0.003 on these instances. The same rounding may shift the rate of 949 other instances by more than 1%. Since the tour and the packing used by the generator were not published, the original rates cannot be recovered. We therefore define new rates with the same rule, applied to a fully specified reference solution that we publish, and we show with a published heuristic that the corrected instances behave as TTP instances again. We also give reference results on the corrected instances and recommendations for future studies. Finally, we present ttplib, a new open-source Python library that loads any of the 9,720 instances, including the corrected ones, without downloading the whole benchmark.
articles.titleCn: 在旅行窃贼基准测试中揭示四个背包问题
articles.abstractCn: 旅行窃贼问题（TTP）要求窃贼选择一个旅行路线和打包方案，Polyakovskiy等人（2014）提出的9,720个实例的基准数据集是用于比较TTP启发式算法的标准测试集。我们证明其中四个实例根本不是TTP实例。这些实例的文件显示租赁率为0.00，因此旅行路线对目标函数没有影响，每个实例都简化为0-1背包问题。其中有一个实例属于通常用于比较新方法的60个分类实例之一，在该实例上，有五个已发表的算法报告了完全相同的结果。原因是文件格式，它保留了两位小数的租赁率，而生成器的规则在这些实例上给出的比率接近0.003。同样的舍入可能导致其他949个实例的比率变化超过1%。由于生成器使用的旅行路线和打包方案未公开发表，原始比率无法恢复。因此，我们根据相同的规则定义了新的比率，应用于我们公开发布的完整指定参考解，并使用已发表的启发式算法证明，修正后的实例再次表现出TTP实例的行为。我们还提供了修正后实例的参考结果，并为未来的研究提出了建议。最后，我们介绍了ttplib，一个新开源的Python库，它可以在不下载整个基准数据集的情况下加载任何9,720个实例，包括修正后的实例。

articles.title: Fairness in Explainable AI Narratives: Decomposing Social Disparities in LLM-Generated Explanations
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate technical explainable AI (XAI) artefacts such as SHAP into explanatory narratives (XAINs) for lay users. In high-risk domains, these explanations are often the main resource through which individuals can understand and contest adverse decisions. Yet LLMs are known to reproduce social bias, even from proxy variables alone, and fairness in XAINs remains unstudied. Because XAINs are bound to a ground-truth artefact, fairness concerns not only what a narrative says and how, but also whether it is equally faithful across social groups. We introduce fairness in XAINs as a new field of research and propose a framework that generates narratives under three conditions (protected attribute disclosed, withheld, or counterfactually swapped), allowing five comparisons that pinpoint the cause of disparities. We apply it to adversely classified instances from four datasets in credit scoring, education and employment, generating narratives with five LLMs, and evaluate faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. We find significant disparities across all datasets, metric families and models, arising in two ways. Faithfulness disparities result from feature values: LLMs make plausible but false statements, triggered by values that are unequally distributed across social groups. Feature coverage and sentiment disparities stem from the protected attribute itself: once it is disclosed, LLMs give less explanation to, or frame more negatively the narratives of, groups that have historically been discriminated against or are stereotypically associated with worse outcomes. A more faithful model removes the faithfulness disparities, and withholding protected attributes mostly removes the others, but neither suffices on its own. Fairness in XAINs should therefore be audited separately from the predictive model and its XAI artefact.
articles.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables. Code, prompts, narratives and extractions available at https://github.com/WannesVandenBulck/fairxain
articles.titleCn: 可解释人工智能叙事中的公平性：分解大型语言模型生成解释中的社会不平等
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于将技术可解释人工智能（XAI）工件（如SHAP）转化为面向普通用户的解释性叙事（XAINs）。在高风险领域，这些解释往往是个人理解和质疑不利决策的主要资源。然而，LLMs已知会复制社会偏见，即使仅从代理变量中也能做到，而XAINs中的公平性仍未被研究。由于XAINs与真实工件绑定，公平性问题不仅关乎叙事内容及其表达方式，还关乎其是否在不同社会群体中保持同等忠实。我们引入XAINs中的公平性作为一项新的研究领域，并提出一个在三种条件（保护属性披露、隐瞒或反事实替换）下生成叙事的框架，允许进行五种比较以确定差异的原因。我们将其应用于信用评分、教育和就业四个数据集中的不利分类实例，使用五个LLMs生成叙事，并评估其忠实度、特征覆盖范围和情感。我们发现所有数据集、指标类别和模型之间都存在显著差异，这些差异产生于两种方式。忠实度差异源于特征值：LLMs做出看似合理但错误的陈述，这些陈述由在不同社会群体中分布不均的值触发。特征覆盖范围和情感差异源于保护属性本身：一旦披露，LLMs对历史上遭受歧视或与更差结果相关联的群体提供的解释较少，或对其叙事进行更负面的框架。更忠实的模型消除了忠实度差异，而隐瞒保护属性主要消除了其他差异，但两者都不能单独解决问题。因此，XAINs中的公平性应与预测模型及其XAI工件分开审计。

articles.title: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.
articles.titleCn: AgentOPSD：基于递归信念修正的回合级归因
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励的强化学习通常在整个轨迹上传播单一优势，这种粒度过于粗略，无法分离出导致长期多轮交互成功的少数决策。特权自蒸馏提供更密集的监督，但未解决如何将一组局部师生差异转换为序列中的信用问题。我们引入AgentOPSD，这是一种无评价者的方案，按交互轮次递归地分配信用。在一轮内，技能条件化的自教师与学生之间的标记级对数概率差距被累加，该累加值作为在以对数优势空间进行的递归贝叶斯更新中的证据；产生的修订通过一个有界且保持符号的多倍器，将结果导出的优势重新分配到各轮次。在ALFWorld上以Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen2.5-7B作为策略主干，该方法在GRPO和自蒸馏基线之上持续改进，并在7B规模上达到89.1%的成功率。消融实验将增益归因于在轮次边界处聚合证据以及使信念修订依赖于历史，而非局部差距本身。

articles.title: Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.
articles.titleCn: 评估乳腺X射线视觉语言模型中的跨信号相干性
articles.abstractCn: 随着视觉语言模型（VLMs）开始直接解读医学影像，它们的输出不仅包含标签，还包含声明的置信度和书面解释。然而，该领域仍然主要使用准确率来评估VLMs。我们使用两个乳腺X光数据集，评估了四个VLMs在乳腺密度和BI-RADS分类上答案、置信度和解释之间的一致性。我们对问题、选择题选项顺序以及图像进行受控扰动，并评估三种输出的变化。我们的结果表明，即使乳腺X光图像发生变化，置信度也不会降低。打乱选项也会改变大多数VLMs的答案。值得注意的是，存在模型自己的声明理由与其最终答案相矛盾的情况，这种区别仅凭准确率无法捕捉，但却决定了人工智能生成的答案是否可信。

articles.title: Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models
articles.abstract: "System 1" decision models (pioneered by TypeSafe AI's Jev) replace autoregressive text generation with a single forward pass returning typed probability distributions over declared schemas (Choice, Score, Noul). While deployed for low-latency routing and automated triage, their statistical calibration and post-hoc explainability remain uncharacterized. We introduce an open, deterministic audit benchmark evaluating System 1 decision models across calibration under label-preserving perturbations, cross-question interference, and post-hoc attribution faithfulness. Evaluating five open-weight models (0.8B to 27B) alongside generative System 2 baselines -- both single-token logprob scoring and structured JSON/CoT decoding -- across NLI (e-SNLI), adversarial syntactic shortcuts (HANS), synthetic clinical triage (N=900), prompt injection defense (Tensor Trust, N=250), and an 86-case logic-gate trigger suite yields five findings: (1) provider confidence is an exact closed-form dispersion transform (1 - H(p)/ln K on sub-10B models; normalized margin on Clef-27B) rather than empirical accuracy; (2) bundling multiple questions in one request induces directional cross-question interference (11.7% to 22.4% binary flips on Tev1-0.8B, vs. 0.1% to 0.2% on Tev1-4B); (3) System 1 models with >= 4B parameters are faster and better calibrated under syntactic shifts (ECE_w = 0.030 to 0.087) than logprob (0.144) and JSON (0.378) baselines; (4) for prompt-injection defense (N=250), >= 4B models achieve 0.988 to 0.998 AUROC with up to 95.2% recall and 0.0% false alarms at 48 to 60 ms; and (5) single-pass inference makes 512-coalition XAI interactive (1.3 to 3.2 s/input), while KernelSHAP with a logit link (S1-SHAP) mitigates softmax saturation on disjunctive OR gates (89.3% to 100.0% gate recovery vs. 57.1% to 82.1% in prob space; p_adj = 0.004).
articles.comment: 36 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Code and benchmark artifacts available at https://github.com/j2launay/jev-decision-models-xai
articles.titleCn: 系统1模型的置信度和决策是否可信？一种基于Jev风格的决策模型的解释性和扰动审计
articles.abstractCn: "系统1"决策模型（由TypeSafe AI的Jev首创）用单次前向传递替代自回归文本生成，返回对声明模式（Choice、Score、Noul）的带类型概率分布。虽然已用于低延迟路由和自动化分诊，但其统计校准和事后可解释性仍未被明确。我们引入一个开放、确定性的审计基准，评估系统1决策模型在标签保持扰动、跨问题干扰和事后归因忠实度下的校准情况。在NLI（e-SNLI）、对抗性句法捷径（HANS）、合成临床分诊（N=900）、提示注入防御（Tensor Trust，N=250）以及一个包含86个案例的逻辑门触发套件中，评估了五个开放权重模型（0.8B至27B）以及生成式系统2基线——单标记logprob评分和结构化JSON/CoT解码——得出五项发现：（1）提供者置信度是精确的闭式分散变换（在小于10B模型上为1 - H(p)/ln K；在Clef-27B上为归一化余量）而非经验准确度；（2）将多个问题捆绑在一个请求中会导致方向性跨问题干扰（在Tev1-0.8B上产生11.7%至22.4%的二进制翻转，而在Tev1-4B上仅为0.1%至0.2%）；（3）参数量大于等于4B的系统1模型在句法变化下校准更快更好（ECE_w = 0.030至0.087），优于logprob（0.144）和JSON（0.378）基线；（4）在提示注入防御（N=250）中，参数量大于等于4B的模型达到0.988至0.998的AUROC，召回率高达95.2%，在48至60毫秒时误报率为0.0%；（5）单次推理使512联盟XAI交互式（每输入1.3至3.2秒），而带有logit链接的KernelSHAP（S1-SHAP）缓解了析取OR门的softmax饱和（在概率空间中门恢复率为57.1%至82.1%，在S1-SHAP中为89.3%至100.0%；p_adj = 0.004）。

articles.title: Text Grouping Changes Completion-Time Comparisons in Long-Form Simultaneous Speech Translation
articles.abstract: Does grouping translation updates before speech synthesis change the measured completion gap between two translators? We compare StreamAtt with its fixed-audio-history baseline on ten English-German talks. For each translation, we keep the intended text and its availability times fixed and vary how updates are grouped for synthesis. Four-second grouping increases StreamAtt's mean completion lead from 106.6 to 229.1 seconds with XTTS-v2, but reduces it from 169.5 to 146.5 seconds with Piper. Both produce shorter audio; different changes in playback idle account for the opposite effects. These directions recur on a separately selected twenty-talk panel. In continuing CosyVoice 3 sessions, grouping instead leaves paired audio unchanged and delays completion on nineteen of twenty blocks. A speech-timing comparison therefore needs to specify how text enters synthesis, not just which synthesizer is used. Recognition and automatic word timing describe the outputs, but do not establish translation accuracy or intelligibility.
articles.titleCn: 文本分组改变长篇同声传译的完成时间比较
articles.abstractCn: 将翻译更新分组后再进行语音合成，是否会影响两个翻译器之间测量的完成差距？我们在十场英语-德语对话中比较了StreamAtt与其固定音频历史的基线。对于每次翻译，我们保持预期文本及其可用时间不变，并改变合成时更新的分组方式。四秒分组使StreamAtt在XTTS-v2上的平均完成领先时间从106.6秒增加到229.1秒，但在Piper上则从169.5秒减少到146.5秒。两者都生成了更短的音频；不同的播放空闲时间变化导致了相反的效果。这些趋势在另外选定的二十场对话面板上再次出现。在CosyVoice 3会话的持续过程中，分组操作反而保持配对音频不变，并在二十个区块中的十九个区块上延迟完成。因此，语音时间同步的比较需要明确文本如何进入合成过程，而不仅仅是使用哪个合成器。识别和自动单词时间描述了输出结果，但并不能确定翻译的准确性或可懂度。

articles.title: Detecting AI-Authored Text in Authentic Student Writing: Evidence from PISA 2025
articles.abstract: AI-text detectors reach near-perfect scores in evaluations that contrast fully human-written texts with texts generated from researcher-designed prompts. In authentic student writing, however, AI use is voluntary and often partial. We study this setting with the PISA 2025 FLA dataset, in which 15-year-olds in Germany wrote English argumentative essays with and without access to a gpt-4o-mini-based chatbot. Keystroke, clipboard and chat logs let us trace every character of the final essay to its origin. From this provenance, we derive text- and sentence-level labels for human-written, AI-generated and mixed text, and for text written after chatbot use without traceable AI material. We evaluate a feature-based detector and a classifier on frozen Llama-3.1-8B embeddings, both adapted from top-ranked shared-task systems. Both separate AI from human text reliably (macro-F1 up to 0.96 for texts and 0.95 for sentences), independently of spelling errors. The feature-based detector, however, relies on lexical complexity, which a simple student-style rewriting prompt removes (AI recall 0.92 $\to$ 0.60 with gpt-4o-mini, 0.41 with Qwen3). The embedding-based detector stays robust for whole texts (AI recall $\geq$ 0.94) but not for single sentences (AI recall as low as 0.59). Mixed text falls between the two classes, and text without traceable AI material is classified as human-written in about 95\% of texts.
articles.titleCn: 在真实学生写作中检测人工智能生成文本：来自PISA 2025的证据
articles.abstractCn: 在对比完全由人类撰写的文本与研究者设计的提示生成的文本的评估中，AI文本检测器达到了近乎完美的分数。然而，在真实的学生写作中，AI的使用是自愿的，并且通常是部分的。我们使用PISA 2025 FLA数据集研究这一场景，其中德国15岁的学生在有和没有访问基于gpt-4o-mini的聊天机器人的情况下撰写了英语议论文。按键记录、剪贴板和聊天记录使我们能够追踪最终论文中的每个字符的来源。从这一来源，我们推导出人类撰写、AI生成和混合文本的文本和句子级标签，以及在没有可追溯的AI材料的聊天机器人使用后撰写的文本。我们在冻结的Llama-3.1-8B嵌入上评估了一个基于特征的检测器和分类器，两者均改编自排名靠前的共享任务系统。两者都能可靠地将AI文本与人类文本区分开来（文本的宏观F1高达0.96，句子的宏观F1高达0.95），且不受拼写错误的影响。然而，基于特征的检测器依赖于词汇复杂性，而简单的学生风格重写提示可以去除这种复杂性（使用gpt-4o-mini时AI召回率从0.92降至0.60，使用Qwen3时降至0.41）。基于嵌入的检测器对整个文本保持稳健（AI召回率≥0.94），但对单个句子则不够稳健（AI召回率低至0.59）。混合文本介于两类之间，而没有可追溯的AI材料的文本在约95%的情况下被归类为人类撰写。

articles.title: Phrase-Level Speculative Decoding on a Frozen Target
articles.abstract: Speculative decoders raise throughput by banking more target tokens per forward pass, and Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark all do it the same way: more candidates that survive verification. All of them draft in the target's own vocabulary, so one node of the candidate tree is one target token, and the tokenizer makes that unit look like a constant. It is not. BPE's pretokenizer splits on whitespace before merges are learned, so no multi-word string can ever become a single token: in Qwen3-4B, "United States of America" is four tokens and no adjacent pair of them exists as one entry, so a phrase is out of reach of any method drafting in the target's vocabulary. We change the unit. A small MLP head reads the frozen target's hidden state and predicts a one- to three-word phrase as one entry in a separate draft vocabulary; greedy longest-match expansion maps it back into the target's own tokens, and N candidates are verified in one forward pass behind a prefix-tree mask, so the change is orthogonal to tree depth and width. The target and its tokenizer stay frozen and a candidate is accepted only while it matches the target's own argmax, so the served output is identical to greedy decoding up to floating-point tie-breaking. On one A5000 at batch 1, against HuggingFace generate(), a 21.94M head (0.545% of Qwen3-4B) reaches 2.391x on GSM8K, 2.444x on MATH-500 and 1.544x on MT-Bench. Because the head's output layer is one row of 257 parameters per entry, the draft vocabulary size is the parameter budget: an 8,000-entry head is 3.434M parameters, 0.0854% of the target and 64x smaller than EAGLE-3's drafter, and keeps 92.3% of the larger head's GSM8K tokens per pass. With EAGLE-3 run on same prompts and baseline, our 21.94M head is ahead of tree-16 on both maths sets and behind tree-60 on every set.
articles.titleCn: 冻结目标上的短语级推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码器通过在单次前向传递中存储更多目标token来提高吞吐量，而Medusa、EAGLE-3、DFlash和DSpark都采用相同的方法：更多通过验证的候选者。它们都在目标词汇表中生成候选者，因此候选树的一个节点就是一个目标token，而分词器使这个单元看起来像是一个常数。但它不是。BPE的预分词器在合并学习之前按空白字符分割，所以任何多词字符串永远不可能成为一个token：在Qwen3-4B中，“United States of America”是四个token，并且没有相邻的一对token作为一个条目存在，因此任何在目标词汇表中生成候选者的方法都无法处理短语。我们改变了单元。一个小型MLP头读取冻结目标的状态并预测一个一到三个词的短语作为单独的条目在另一个生成词汇表中；贪婪最长匹配扩展将其映射回目标自己的token，并在前缀树掩码后的一次前向传递中验证N个候选者，因此这种改变与树深度和宽度无关。目标和它的分词器保持冻结，并且只有当候选者与目标自己的argmax匹配时才被接受，因此提供的输出与贪婪解码直到浮点数平局为止相同。在一台A5000上，批处理为1，与HuggingFace generate()对比，一个21.94M头（占Qwen3-4B的0.545%）在GSM8K上达到2.391倍，在MATH-500上达到2.444倍，在MT-Bench上达到1.544倍。因为头的输出层每个条目是257个参数的一行，所以生成词汇表的大小是参数预算：一个8,000条目的头是3.434M参数，占目标的0.0854%，比EAGLE-3的生成器小64倍，并且保持了更大头的92.3%的GSM8K每次传递的token。在相同提示和基线下运行EAGLE-3，我们的21.94M头在两个数学集上领先于tree-16，在所有集上落后于tree-60。

articles.title: Can Frontier Auto Researchers Reconstruct Human Research Decisions in AI?
articles.abstract: Scientific research has long been driven by substantial human effort, from reviewing prior work and identifying research gaps to designing specific solutions. Recent advances in harness-based agent systems have given rise to increasingly capable Auto Researchers, which can autonomously carry out these tasks and, increasingly, entire end-to-end research workflows. Yet despite their rapidly growing capabilities, how closely the research decisions and outputs produced by auto researchers align with those of human experts remains underexplored. We investigate this gap through the lens of research reconstruction and study: Given comparable research context, how similar are the research decisions and outputs produced by Auto Researchers to those of human researchers in AI research? To answer this question, we introduce AutoResearcher-Human Research Similarity (AutoHRS), a stage-wise evaluation framework for assessing how faithfully auto researchers reconstruct human research artifacts across different stages of the scientific workflow. Using 152 ICLR oral papers as our corpus, we generate 456 research trajectories spanning different stages of the research process. Applying AutoHRS to these trajectories, we find that current Auto Researchers frequently fail to recover key research decisions and their resulting artifacts across multiple stages of the research process.
articles.titleCn: 边界汽车研究人员能否重构人类在人工智能中的研究决策？
articles.abstractCn: 科学研究长期以来一直依赖于大量的人类努力，从回顾已有工作、识别研究空白到设计具体解决方案。近年来，基于代理系统的进步催生了越来越强大的自动研究人员，他们能够自主完成这些任务，并且越来越多地执行整个端到端的研究工作流程。然而，尽管自动研究人员的能力迅速增长，但它们产生的研究决策和成果与人类专家的决策和成果的一致程度仍然有待探索。我们通过研究重建的视角来探讨这一差距：在可比的研究背景下，自动研究人员在人工智能研究中产生的研究决策和成果与人类研究人员相比有多相似？为了回答这个问题，我们引入了自动研究人员-人类研究相似度（AutoHRS），这是一个分阶段的评估框架，用于评估自动研究人员在不同科学工作流程阶段重建人类研究工件的程度。使用152篇ICLR口头论文作为语料库，我们生成了涵盖研究过程不同阶段的研究轨迹456条。应用AutoHRS到这些轨迹上，我们发现当前的自动研究人员在研究过程的多阶段中经常无法恢复关键的研究决策及其产生的成果。

articles.title: Path-Level Structural and Semantic Alignment for Hierarchical Multi-Label Text Classification
articles.abstract: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) requires models to capture both structural dependencies among labels and the fine-grained semantics of labels at different hierarchy levels. Existing methods often model hierarchy through prediction constraints or representations of individual labels and local relations. Structural and semantic supervision, however, are usually formulated separately. We instead use complete root-to-node label paths as a shared unit for both. Our framework introduces two auxiliary training objectives while retaining a standard multi-label classifier at inference. PathSimNCE aligns document representations with hierarchical paths using hierarchy-aware contrastive targets. These targets provide graded supervision for structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. The complementary semantic objective uses LLM-generated, document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths. It thereby provides context-specific label semantics beyond static label representations. Experiments on three benchmarks show consistent improvements: structural alignment is particularly beneficial in deeper hierarchies, while semantic alignment provides additional gains for fine-grained labels.
articles.titleCn: 层级多标签文本分类中的路径级结构语义对齐
articles.abstractCn: 层级多标签文本分类（HMTC）要求模型既要捕捉标签间的结构依赖关系，也要理解不同层级标签的细粒度语义。现有方法通常通过预测约束或单个标签及其局部关系的表示来建模层级结构。然而，结构和语义监督通常被分开构建。我们则采用完整的从根节点到叶节点的标签路径作为两者的共享单元。我们的框架在推理时保留标准的多标签分类器，同时引入两个辅助训练目标。PathSimNCE利用层级感知对比目标将文档表示与层级路径对齐。这些目标为结构相关的路径提供分级监督，同时保留对真实路径的显式监督。互补的语义目标使用大型语言模型生成的、文档条件化的相同正路径描述，从而在静态标签表示之外提供特定上下文的标签语义。在三个基准数据集上的实验显示了一致性的改进：结构对齐在更深层级中特别有益，而语义对齐为细粒度标签提供了额外增益。

articles.title: Unprompted coordination through shared memory in LLM agents: a locked two-implementation replication and extension
articles.abstract: Coordination between large language-model agents has become a central question for AI safety and software engineering, as such agents are deployed in groups that share infrastructure. Existing research tells the agents that partners exist or asks them to coordinate. Whether coordination arises through shared state alone, with nothing disclosing that anyone else is present, is the key question for deployments that share caches and memory between agents, yet it has rarely been examined, and never with independent replication; this study does both. Four agents each received a short arithmetic task and a key-value store presented to each as its own scratch space; two held complementary halves of one computation, and no prompt mentioned other agents, sharing or collaboration. For reliability, the environment was rebuilt independently from a written protocol, and both implementations ran under hashed locks on design, data and analysis. The results bear novelty value in three respects. Joint success occurred only through the shared store. Whether a model coordinated depended not on its vendor tier but on whether it wrote its intermediate result and looked at the store again, and one ordinary sentence, "check your workspace again before submitting", switched that second look on and off. The findings held under replication. For practice, state shared between agents is a communication channel and should be separated, namespaced and logged. For research, designs should be locked before the data, and the parse rule, endpoint and parameters reported. Future work should test open-weight models and separate using another agent's output from intending to communicate.

articles.titleCn: 在LLM智能体中通过共享内存进行无提示协调：一项锁定双实现复制与扩展研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理之间的协调已成为人工智能安全和软件工程的核心问题，因为这些代理被部署在共享基础设施的群体中。现有研究告诉代理存在合作伙伴或要求它们进行协调。对于在代理之间共享缓存和内存的部署，关键问题是协调是否仅通过共享状态产生，且没有任何信息表明其他人存在，但这很少被研究，也从未进行过独立复制；本研究同时解决了这两个问题。每个代理都收到了一个简短的算术任务和一个键值存储，每个代理将其视为自己的临时空间；其中两个持有同一计算任务互补的两部分，且没有任何提示提及其他代理、共享或协作。为确保可靠性，环境根据书面协议独立重建，并且两个实现都在设计、数据和分析上运行在哈希锁下。结果在三个方面具有新颖性价值。联合成功仅通过共享存储发生。模型是否协调取决于其供应商层级，而取决于它是否写入中间结果并再次查看存储，以及一句普通的话，“提交前请再次检查你的工作空间”，可以打开或关闭这种第二次查看。这一发现适用于复制。对于实践，代理之间共享的状态是一种通信信道，应该进行隔离、命名和记录。对于研究，设计应该在数据之前锁定，并且应报告解析规则、端点和参数。未来的工作应该测试开放权重模型，并使用另一个代理的输出来区分意图进行通信。

articles.title: BDBBQ: A Human-AI Collaborative Benchmark for Bengali Social Bias in LLMs
articles.abstract: Despite growing attention to social bias in large language models (LLMs), existing bias benchmarks provide limited coverage of culturally grounded evaluation in Bengali, particularly within Bangladesh's sociocultural context. To address this gap, we develop a bilingual extension of BanglaBBQ comprising 61,312 question-answering instances across 12 social categories in English and Bengali. The benchmark incorporates balanced answer permutations, contrasting question framings, and both ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to systematically examine model performance and stereotype-aligned bias across languages. We validate the dataset through structural checks, 220 statistical tests, and expert annotation of 150 instances by four annotators, achieving strong inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss' \k{appa}=0.8349). We evaluate eight LLMs across 490,496 instances and identify five key findings. First, disambiguated contexts yield substantially greater accuracy improvements in Bengali (+36.59 percentage points) than in English (+17.71). Second, all evaluated models exhibit lower accuracy in Bengali, although Mistral-Nemo shows the smallest cross-lingual accuracy gap (5.12 percentage points). Third, stereotype-aligned bias exhibits language and model dependent variation, increasing in Bengali for Gemma 2 9B but decreasing for Mistral-Nemo. Fourth, higher accuracy does not necessarily correspond to lower stereotype-aligned bias. Finally, bias varies considerably across social categories, with Qwen 2.5 7B exhibiting stronger stereotype alignment in Bengali for Politics and Physical Appearance. These findings demonstrate that cross-lingual performance and social bias are distinct dimensions of LLM behavior and underscore the importance of culturally grounded, language-sensitive benchmarks for evaluating fairness beyond English-centric settings.
articles.titleCn: BDBBQ：一个用于孟加拉语社交偏见的LLM人机协作基准
articles.abstractCn: 尽管对大型语言模型（LLM）中的社会偏见日益关注，现有的偏见基准在孟加拉语的文化基础评估方面覆盖有限，尤其是在孟加拉国的社会文化背景下。为填补这一空白，我们开发了一个双语的BanglaBBQ扩展，包含61,312个跨12个社会类别的英孟双语问答实例。该基准集纳入了平衡的答案排列、对比性的问题框架，以及模糊和明确化的上下文，以系统性地检验模型性能和与刻板印象相关的偏见。我们通过结构检查、220项统计测试以及四位标注员对150个实例的专家标注来验证数据集，实现了高度的一致性（Fleiss' \k{appa}=0.8349）。我们评估了八个LLM在490,496个实例上的表现，并确定了五个关键发现。首先，明确化的上下文在孟加拉语中带来的准确率提升（+36.59个百分点）显著高于英语（+17.71）。其次，所有评估的模型在孟加拉语的准确率均较低，尽管Mistral-Nemo的跨语言准确率差距最小（5.12个百分点）。第三，与刻板印象相关的偏见表现出语言和模型依赖的变异，在孟加拉语中，Gemma 2 9B的偏见增加，而Mistral-Nemo的偏见减少。第四，更高的准确率并不一定对应更低的与刻板印象相关的偏见。最后，偏见在社会类别间差异显著，Qwen 2.5 7B在孟加拉语中的政治和身体外观类别表现出更强的刻板印象一致性。这些发现表明，跨语言性能和社会偏见是LLM行为的两个不同维度，并强调了在超越以英语为中心的背景下评估公平性时，具有文化基础和语言敏感性的基准的重要性。

articles.title: More Than Just Style: Benchmarking Personality Influence in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: In addition to the effects of explicit input prompts and instructions, large language model outputs are influenced by underlying behavioral preferences similar to human personality tendencies. These tendencies can affect how models interpret situations and make decisions. However, their influence is difficult to disentangle from the effects of model capabilities and instructions. Therefore, we introduce SPACE, a benchmark framework combining a controlled evaluation protocol with complementary datasets for personality verification, capability assessment, and hierarchical situational tasks. Controlled comparisons across guidance conditions help distinguish personality influence from measured capability changes and immediate instruction effects. Experimental results demonstrate that although prompting can shift generation style, models' internal personality tendencies are persistent and not readily overridden by opposing instructions. Furthermore, these underlying tendencies have an observable influence on LLM task performance, highlighting the need for greater attention to these characteristics and potential applications. Training code and SPACE benchmark specifications are available at https://github.com/Niklauseik/SPACE-training.
articles.titleCn: 不只是风格：大型语言模型中人格影响基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 除了明确的输入提示和指令的影响外，大型语言模型的输出还受到类似于人类性格倾向的潜在行为偏好的影响。这些倾向会影响模型对情境的解读和决策方式。然而，这些倾向的影响很难与模型能力和指令的效果区分开来。因此，我们引入了SPACE，这是一个基准框架，结合了受控评估协议和用于性格验证、能力评估以及分层情境任务的互补数据集。在不同指导条件下的受控比较有助于区分性格影响、测量的能力变化以及即时指令效果。实验结果表明，尽管提示可以改变生成风格，但模型的内部性格倾向是持久的，并且不容易被相反的指令所覆盖。此外，这些潜在倾向对LLM任务性能有可观察的影响，突出了对这些特征以及潜在应用给予更多关注的必要性。训练代码和SPACE基准规范可在https://github.com/Niklauseik/SPACE-training获取。

articles.title: MNN-Pocket-0.3B Technical Report
articles.abstract: This technical report presents MNN-Pocket-0.3B, a compact 300M-parameter dense language model designed for efficient on-device deployment and supporting context lengths of up to 32K tokens. With an INT4 deployment footprint of only 173 MB and decoding throughput of up to 466 tokens/s on iPad Pro M5 (Metal), it can be seamlessly integrated into applications on edge devices such as smartphones and smart glasses. MNN-Pocket-0.3B is developed through the co-design of its architecture, data, training pipeline, and inference system. Hardware-aware architecture selection and dependency-aware vocabulary pruning balance model capability with on-device memory and compute constraints. A four-stage pre-training pipeline covering approximately 4.1 trillion high-quality Chinese and English tokens equips the model with broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities. This is followed by a three-stage post-training pipeline comprising instruction fine-tuning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and quantization-aware training. Finally, hardware-specific optimizations in the MNN inference engine enable fast, memory-efficient inference and long-context processing. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MNN-Pocket-0.3B achieves frontier-level performance among models of comparable size, with particularly strong results in Chinese and English knowledge and reasoning, mathematics, coding, and instruction following. It consistently outperforms similarly sized open-source models and even surpasses several 0.5B-parameter models on instruction-following benchmarks. We release MNN-Pocket-0.3B with open weights and ready-to-use MNN deployment packages. We hope it will provide a practical foundation for capable, responsive, and memory-efficient edge applications while advancing research and development in on-device language models.
articles.titleCn: MNN-Pocket-0.3B技术报告
articles.abstractCn: 本技术报告介绍了MNN-Pocket-0.3B，这是一个紧凑型300M参数密集语言模型，专为高效设备端部署设计，并支持高达32K token的上下文长度。在仅173 MB的INT4部署占用空间和iPad Pro M5（Metal）上高达466 tokens/s的解码吞吐量下，它可以无缝集成到智能手机和智能眼镜等边缘设备应用中。MNN-Pocket-0.3B通过其架构、数据、训练流程和推理系统的协同设计而开发。硬件感知的架构选择和依赖感知的词汇剪枝在模型能力与设备内存和计算限制之间取得了平衡。一个涵盖约4.1万亿高质量中英文token的四阶段预训练流程为模型配备了广泛的知识和推理能力。随后是一个包含指令微调、多导师策略蒸馏和量化感知训练的三阶段后训练流程。最后，MNN推理引擎中的硬件特定优化实现了快速、内存高效的推理和长上下文处理。广泛的评估表明，MNN-Pocket-0.3B在同等规模的模型中达到了前沿性能水平，尤其在中英文知识、推理、数学、编程和指令遵循方面表现突出。它始终优于同等规模的开源模型，甚至在指令遵循基准测试中超越了几个0.5B参数模型。我们以开源权重和现成的MNN部署包发布了MNN-Pocket-0.3B。我们希望它能为基础强大的、响应迅速且内存高效的边缘应用提供实用基础，同时推动设备端语言模型的研究与开发。

articles.title: HumanSightBench: A Benchmark for Human Visual Perception in MLLMs
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on knowledge-intensive and reasoning-based vision-language benchmark datasets, but still struggle to solve the visual questions that people can solve easily. Evaluating the differences between MLLMs and human-level visual perception is challenging due to end-to-end evaluation which combines various skills, or because we are uncertain if individual items are valid. Specifically, observed errors may reflect visual perception, language priors, background knowledge, question ambiguity, and underspecified answers. Our guideline for HumanSightBench is that we construct items that are human-easy by construction and model-hard by evaluation. HumanSightBench contains 2,876 visual questions with short answers across 7 top-level perceptual categories and 21 subcategories. We only include items that pass five inclusion gates: question clarity, answer uniqueness, visual grounding, human solvability, and text-only shortcut filtering. According to the protocol, errors are defined as incorrect answers on human-validated visual tasks with the evaluated interface. The inclusion gates are intended to reduce confounds from ambiguity and external knowledge. The best pass@3 score is 65.6% across eight evaluated MLLMs. No evaluated model exceeds 27.5% on Counting. These results identify capability gaps that are hidden by overall scores and can help future training experiments and held-out evaluation.
articles.titleCn: HumanSightBench：用于MLLMs中人类视觉感知的基准
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在知识密集型和推理型视觉语言基准数据集上表现出色，但仍难以解决人类能轻易解决的视觉问题。由于端到端评估结合了多种技能，或因为我们不确定单个项目的有效性，评估MLLMs与人类水平视觉感知之间的差异具有挑战性。具体而言，观察到的错误可能反映视觉感知、语言先验知识、背景知识、问题模糊性以及答案不明确性。HumanSightBench的指导原则是构建人类易于理解但模型难以解决的问题。HumanSightBench包含2,876个视觉短答案问题，分布在7个顶层感知类别和21个子类别中。我们仅包含通过五个纳入门槛的项目：问题清晰度、答案唯一性、视觉基础、人类可解性以及纯文本捷径过滤。根据协议，错误定义为在人类验证的视觉任务中，使用评估界面给出的错误答案。纳入门槛旨在减少由模糊性和外部知识引起的混杂因素。在八种评估的MLLMs中，最高pass@3分数为65.6%。在计数任务上，没有评估模型超过27.5%。这些结果揭示了被整体分数隐藏的能力差距，有助于未来的训练实验和留出评估。

articles.title: Agent4Crypto: A Dual-Reflective and Market-Feedback-Aligned LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Cryptocurrency Trading
articles.abstract: Cryptocurrency markets provide a natural testbed for autonomous AI agents because they are digital-native, high-frequency, and machine-speed environments, yet existing methods often struggle with non-stationary market regimes, opaque decisions, and fixed aggregation rules. In this paper, we propose Agent4Crypto, a dual-reflective and market-feedback-aligned multi-agent system. The framework coordinates specialized agents for data collection, analysis, risk assessment, reflection, and trading, synthesizing heterogeneous signals from prices, indicators, news, and charts in an interpretable decision pipeline. Our central design is a trader-centric decision mechanism: three style-specific trader agents, Aggressive, Neutral, and Conservative, generate candidate actions and natural-language rationales from the same market context, while their influence is learned rather than manually fixed. A PPO-based gating policy dynamically allocates trader weights through a dual-reflective feedback process. One reflection stream evaluates post-trade decision quality from realized portfolio outcomes and distills reusable lessons into a Financial ReasoningBank for retrieval in subsequent trader prompts, while the other estimates trader-level counterfactual contribution, indicating which style has recently aligned better with market movements. The PPO state combines Counterfactual Contribution Memory with market features, previous trader weights, and current trader actions, so trader influence adapts across bull, sideways, and bear regimes. Experiments on BTC, ETH, and XRP show that Agent4Crypto improves total return and Sharpe ratio over traditional strategies, machine learning and reinforcement learning baselines, and existing LLM-based trading systems, demonstrating the value of interpretable trader competition and market-feedback-driven adaptation in volatile cryptocurrency markets.
