articles.titleCn: Agent4Crypto：一种基于大型语言模型的、双反射和市场反馈对齐的多智能体系统，用于加密货币交易
articles.abstractCn: 加密货币市场为自主AI代理提供了天然的试验平台，因为它们是数字原生、高频交易和机器速度的环境，但现有方法往往难以应对非平稳的市场状态、不透明的决策以及固定的聚合规则。在本文中，我们提出了Agent4Crypto，一个双重反射和市场反馈对齐的多智能体系统。该框架协调专门用于数据收集、分析、风险评估、反思和交易的智能体，将价格、指标、新闻和图表的异构信号综合到一个可解释的决策流程中。我们的核心设计是一个以交易者为中心的决策机制：三种风格特定的交易者智能体——激进型、中性和保守型——从相同的市场环境中生成候选行动和自然语言理由，而它们的影响力是通过学习而非手动固定的。基于PPO的门控策略通过双重反射反馈过程动态分配交易者权重。一个反射流从实际投资组合结果评估交易后决策质量，并将可重用的经验提炼到金融推理库中，供后续交易者提示检索；另一个流估计交易者级别的反事实贡献，表明哪种风格最近与市场变动更为一致。PPO状态结合反事实贡献记忆与市场特征、先前交易者权重和当前交易者行动，使交易者影响力能在牛市、横盘和熊市环境中自适应调整。在BTC、ETH和XRP上的实验表明，Agent4Crypto在传统策略、机器学习和强化学习基线以及现有的基于LLM的交易系统上，提升了总回报和夏普比率，证明了可解释交易者竞争和市场反馈驱动适应在波动性加密货币市场中的价值。

articles.title: Prune, Don't Merge: Expert Compression of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs on Multilingual Production Tasks
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts language models are cheap to run per token but expensive to hold in GPU memory, which drives the cost of serving them in production. One-shot expert compression shrinks them after a single calibration pass. Its two current state-of-the-art methods are REAP for expert pruning, which deletes the least salient experts, and REAM for expert merging, which merges them into the most salient ones. Both have been evaluated only on academic benchmarks. We compare the two on five multilingual production tasks of a web-hosting company, from classification to the generation of marketing HTML email templates, with two 30B-parameter models (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 and the hybrid Mamba-attention Nemotron-3.5-Lightning) at 25% and 50% of experts removed and the same calibration data. Pruning wins: on the same rows, REAP is significantly better in 16 of 20 comparisons and REAM in 2. At 25%, REAP keeps 93.6% of Qwen3-30B's generative quality and REAM 62.5%, although on benchmarks the two are within a point for the same model. The damage concentrates in the output contract rather than the content: 89.8-95.2% of each significant loss on email templates comes from hard-gate failures such as invalid JSON, broken mobile layouts and runaway generation, and most failed non-English domain descriptions copy the prompt's English opening phrase. Cross-perplexity and logit divergence, two diagnostics from the REAP paper, also track production quality, as does the rate of repetition loops; n-gram diversity does not. We close with practical guidance for compressing MoE models for production.
articles.titleCn: 精简而非合并：多语言生产任务上专家混合大型语言模型的专家压缩
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合语言模型在单个token上的运行成本较低，但在GPU内存中的存储成本高昂，这导致其在生产环境中的服务成本居高不下。单次专家压缩在单次校准后即可缩小模型。其当前最先进的两种方法是用于专家剪枝的REAP，删除最不显著的专家，以及用于专家合并的REAM，将它们合并到最显著的专家中。这两种方法目前仅在学术基准上进行了评估。我们在一家网络托管公司的五种多语言生产任务上对这两种方法进行了比较，包括分类到生成营销HTML邮件模板，使用两个30B参数模型（Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507和混合Mamba-注意力Nemotron-3.5-Lightning），分别移除了25%和50%的专家，并使用相同的校准数据。剪枝获胜：在同一行中，REAP在20次比较中有16次表现显著更好，REAM有2次。在25%的情况下，REAP保持了Qwen3-30B生成质量的93.6%，REAM为62.5%，尽管在基准测试中，对于同一模型，两者的差距不到一个点。损害集中在输出契约而非内容上：89.8-95.2%的邮件模板显著损失来自硬门失败，如无效的JSON、损坏的移动布局和失控生成，而大多数失败的英文域名描述复制了提示的英文开头短语。交叉困惑度和logit发散，REAP论文中的两种诊断方法，也跟踪生产质量，重复循环速率也是如此；n-gram多样性则没有。最后，我们提供了压缩MoE模型用于生产的实用指导。

articles.title: A Cost That Practice Accuracy Hides: Worked Solutions in Self-Generated Training Data and the Compositional Use of New Rules
articles.abstract: A worked solution can make self-generated training targets shorter and cheaper, but accuracy on the practiced operation may hide how well a model can reuse newly learned rules. We study this choice in a 2B-parameter reasoning model learning two invented quantitative rules. The model generates targets from a rule sheet alone or from the sheet plus a program-written worked solution; targets are accepted for final-answer correctness, and the support is removed for fine-tuning and evaluation. Training questions request forward use in one segment; composition requires sequential reuse of the same rule across two segments. After six passes, using a program-checked numerical signature, sheet-only targets lead by 24.3 percentage points (95% item-bootstrap CI 14.6-34.0) on composition in a prospective test. On unseen argument values, observed forward accuracy is identical (87.5% each), but composition accuracy is 58.3% versus 23.6%, a 34.7-point gap (25.7-43.8). An independently sampled second target-bank pair repeats the direction (+14.6 points, 2.1-26.0). Ten passes on the shorter worked-solution targets, approximately matching the domain tokens of six sheet-only passes while changing other training quantities, narrow the gap to 16.3 points (6.3-26.7) in the first bank pair and 6.2 points (-6.3 to 18.8) in the second, where the pre-specified test does not hold. At six passes each, the worked-solution policy uses fewer capture tokens and less update time, yet the trained models use 2.6 times as many generated tokens per composition success under the numerical signature (2.1 times in the second bank pair). Choosing a capture context therefore requires testing how the new rules are reused, alongside the inference cost of those uses, rather than relying on forward accuracy alone.
articles.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code, data and trained adapters: https://github.com/JetXu-LLM/kestrel-capture-context
articles.titleCn: 一项被练习精度隐藏的成本：自我生成的训练数据中的已解决方案以及新规则的组合使用
articles.abstractCn: 一个经过处理的解决方案可以使自生成的训练目标更短、更经济，但练习操作上的准确率可能掩盖了模型重用新学习规则的能力。我们在一个学习两个发明定量规则的2B参数推理模型中研究了这一选择。该模型仅从规则表或从规则表加上程序编写的经过处理的解决方案中生成目标；目标接受最终答案的正确性，并在微调和评估时移除支持。训练问题要求在一个片段中进行正向使用；组合需要跨两个片段顺序重用同一规则。经过六次迭代，在前瞻性测试中，使用程序检查的数值签名，仅使用规则表的目标在组合上领先24.3个百分点（95%项目引导CI为14.6-34.0）。在未见过的论值上，观察到的正向准确率相同（各87.5%），但组合准确率为58.3%对23.6%，差距为34.7个百分点（25.7-43.8）。一个独立采样的第二个目标库对重复了方向（+14.6个百分点，2.1-26.0）。在更短的经过处理的解决方案目标上进行十次迭代，大约匹配了六次仅使用规则表的领域标记数，同时改变了其他训练量，缩小了第一库对中的差距至16.3个百分点（6.3-26.7），在第二库对中缩小至6.2个百分点（-6.3至18.8），其中预指定的测试不成立。在每次六次迭代中，经过处理的解决方案策略使用更少的捕获标记和更少的更新时间，但训练模型在数值签名下每成功一次组合生成2.6倍的标记（在第二库对中为2.1倍）。因此，选择捕获上下文需要在测试新规则如何被重用及其推理成本的同时，而不是仅依赖正向准确率。

articles.title: A Geometric Invariant of Attention Predicts Head Specialization from Weights Alone
articles.abstract: Transformers are built with continuous symmetries in the attention mechanism. We derive $ρ$, a scalar invariant that measures each head's capacity to couple to rotary positional encodings. This framework allows us to analyze heads without forward passes, opening a new research direction into data-independent analysis of modern LLMs. Empirically, we find that $ρ$ predicts induction heads, the most-studied circuit type in mechanistic interpretability, with Spearman correlation between $-0.55$ and $-0.74$ across four bias-free RoPE models spanning $135$M to $7$B parameters. As a preliminary proof of concept, we use $ρ$ to apply YaRN to only the top-50% positional heads, which degrades perplexity less than uniform application. Code is available at https://github.com/MPedraBento/rho-invariant.
articles.comment: Accepted as an extended abstract at the Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations Workshop (NeurReps), NeurIPS 2026
articles.titleCn: 一个注意力几何不变量仅通过权重预测头专门化
articles.abstractCn: 注意力机制中的Transformer具有连续对称性。我们推导出标量不变量$ρ$，用于衡量每个注意力头与旋转位置编码耦合的能力。该框架使我们能够在无需前向传递的情况下分析注意力头，为现代大型语言模型的数据无关性分析开辟了新的研究方向。实证结果表明，$ρ$能够预测归纳头（mechanistic interpretability中最广泛研究的电路类型），在四个参数规模从$135$M到$7$B的无偏RoPE模型中，其Spearman相关系数介于$-0.55$和$-0.74$之间。作为概念验证的初步尝试，我们使用$ρ$仅对前50%的位置编码头应用YaRN，其困惑度下降程度低于均匀应用。代码可在https://github.com/MPedraBento/rho-invariant获取。

articles.title: TrajLift: Lifting Memory Recall Trajectories with Latency-Modulated Heat Diffusion
articles.abstract: Verbal memory retrieval carries rich diagnostic information for Alzheimer's disease through the order, hesitation, and categorical organization of recalled words, yet computational modeling of this retrieval process remains largely unexplored. A key challenge is that timing and hierarchical structure are diagnostically entangled: the diagnostic meaning of retrieval timing depends on its hierarchical context. We propose TrajLift, a spectral framework that models verbal recall as timed trajectories on a hierarchical graph. Our central mechanism is latency-modulated heat diffusion on the semantic hierarchy, a unified operator that lifts each recalled word into a representation of both multi-scale hierarchical structure and continuous retrieval timing. Formal analysis shows that the resulting representation is first-order separable into structural and temporal components with spectral selectivity across hierarchical levels. On synthetic benchmarks requiring structure-time interaction, TrajLift stays near-perfect on deep hierarchies where all baselines fail. On real-world clinical data, we show that TrajLift outperforms diverse baselines by jointly modeling timing and semantic structure, with gains that grow as retrieval timing becomes more informative.
articles.titleCn: TrajLift：通过延迟调制热扩散提升记忆召回轨迹
articles.abstractCn: 语言记忆提取通过回忆词语的顺序、犹豫和分类组织，为阿尔茨海默病提供了丰富的诊断信息，然而，对这一提取过程的计算建模仍基本未得到探索。一个关键挑战是时间和层次结构在诊断上相互纠缠：提取时间的诊断意义取决于其层次上下文。我们提出了TrajLift，一个频谱框架，将语言回忆建模为在层次图上的时间轨迹。我们的核心机制是语义层次上的延迟调制热扩散，这是一个统一的算子，将每个回忆的词语提升为多尺度层次结构和连续提取时间的表示。形式分析表明，所得表示可以按层次级别进行频谱选择性分离为结构和时间分量。在需要结构-时间交互的合成基准测试中，TrajLift在所有基线都失败的深层层次上仍保持近乎完美的表现。在真实世界的临床数据上，我们展示了TrajLift通过联合建模时间和语义结构优于多样化基线，并且随着提取时间信息的增加，其优势也随之增长。

articles.title: The Deception Archive as a repository of standardized datasets for large-scale verbal deception detection research
articles.abstract: Computational advances in natural language processing and machine learning have substantially expanded the use of automated approaches in verbal deception research. However, existing verbal deception datasets remain fragmented across disciplines, as they are often difficult to identify, access, and reuse, limiting cross-study comparisons and the development of robust computational models. We present the Deception Archive, a curated and standardized repository of publicly available verbal deception datasets built upon a large-scale systematic review. Eligible datasets were retrieved, manually inspected, and standardized following a structured data curation workflow. The current repository comprises 41 publicly available datasets containing 387,995 truthful or deceptive statements. The archive represents a heterogeneous repository (e.g., in data size, topic of investigation, ground-truth, etc.) and a living resource for integrating newly available deception datasets over time. By providing centralized access to standardized datasets and accompanying metadata, the Deception Archive facilitates dataset discovery, cross-dataset validation, and reproducible evaluation of computational models.
articles.titleCn: 作为大规模言语欺骗检测研究的标准化数据集库，欺骗档案
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言处理和机器学习的计算进展极大地扩展了自动化方法在言语欺骗研究中的应用。然而，现有的言语欺骗数据集仍然分散在不同学科之间，因为它们通常难以识别、获取和重用，这限制了跨研究比较和鲁棒计算模型的发展。我们提出了欺骗档案（Deception Archive），这是一个基于大规模系统性综述构建的、经过编辑和标准化的公开言语欺骗数据集存储库。符合条件的数招建被检索、人工检查，并遵循结构化的数据编辑工作流程进行标准化。当前存储库包含41个公开可用的数据集，其中包含387,995条真实或欺骗性陈述。该档案代表了一个异构存储库（例如，在数据大小、研究主题、真实标签等方面），并且是一个随着时间的推移可以集成新可用欺骗数据集的活资源。通过提供对标准化数据集及其伴随元数据的集中访问，欺骗档案促进了数据集发现、跨数据集验证以及计算模型的可重复评估。

articles.title: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
articles.abstract: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious. Yet AI scientists are typically given as much task information as possible during idea generation, which can anchor generation toward familiar approaches. Inspired by the cognitive framework of Blind Variation and Selective Retention (BVSR), we propose a discovery framework that separates these two roles of information: it generates proposals under deliberately limited task information to broaden exploration, then learns from proposals previously verified on the same task and their outcomes to retain promising candidates for costly empirical evaluation. We evaluate BVSR across five proposer models and 12 scientific tasks. Limiting task information substantially increases proposal originality and non-obviousness, and produces a larger share of highly creative and high-utility proposals than existing state-of-the-art prompting-based baselines. Learning from prior proposal outcomes on the task further improves candidate selection, discarding half of the candidates while retaining most top-performing proposals. When incorporated into existing AI-scientist workflows, BVSR achieves stronger discoveries across gene expression analysis, drug response prediction, anomaly detection, scaling law discovery, and brain activity prediction. These results suggest that effective AI scientists should use information differently across stages of discovery: constrain task-specific information during exploration while exploiting accumulated empirical experience on the task.
articles.titleCn: 盲变，选择性保留：提升人工智能科学家创意生成能力
articles.abstractCn: 科学发现需要原创、实用且非显而易见的想法。然而，在AI科学家进行想法生成时，通常会尽可能提供任务信息，这可能导致生成过程倾向于熟悉的方法。受盲变异性与选择性保留（BVSR）认知框架的启发，我们提出了一种发现框架，该框架将信息的两种角色分离：在故意限制的任务信息下生成提案以拓宽探索范围，然后从先前在同一任务上验证的提案及其结果中学习，以保留有潜力的候选者进行昂贵的实证评估。我们在五种提案模型和十二项科学任务上评估了BVSR。限制任务信息显著提高了提案的原创性和非显而易见性，并比现有的基于提示的基准方法产生了更多具有高度创造性和高实用性的提案。从任务先前提案结果中学习进一步改进了候选者选择，淘汰了半数候选者，同时保留了大多数表现优异的提案。当集成到现有的AI科学家工作流程中时，BVSR在基因表达分析、药物响应预测、异常检测、幂律发现和脑活动预测等方面实现了更强的发现。这些结果表明，有效的AI科学家应在发现的不同阶段以不同的方式使用信息：在探索阶段限制特定任务信息，同时利用任务积累的实证经验。

articles.title: TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval
articles.abstract: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. To address the challenges, we propose TS-GEAR, a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery: (1) Geo-Semantic ID splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes, making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter; (2) Query-Geo Target Attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets, while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key; (3) GMPO (Group Marginal Policy Optimization) rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within GRPO, avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. Deployed online with a lightweight 0.1B backbone, TS-GEAR serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of Taobao Shangou, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both HitRate and geographic validity, and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.
articles.titleCn: TS-GEAR：淘宝商搜生成式广告召回
articles.abstractCn: 像DoorDash和Uber Eats这样的即时配送平台在传统电子商务中不存在一个约束条件：超出用户配送范围的商家被视为无效候选，而不仅仅是排名较低。生成式检索最近在大规模检索系统中展现出巨大潜力。然而，将其应用于此场景提出了三个挑战。首先，现有的语义ID仅将地理位置编码为软信号，因此可达性只能依赖非可微分的生成后硬截断。其次，用户偏好在不同地区和查询之间存在显著差异，因此在不考虑地理位置和当前查询的情况下聚合历史行为会导致有偏的兴趣估计。第三，检索到的候选集通过其整体价值进行评估，但自回归训练独立评分每个序列，没有集合级别的信号来抑制冗余的近似重复。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了TS-GEAR，一个用于即时配送的统一生成式检索框架：(1) 地理语义ID将商家标识符拆分为地理前缀和语义后缀，使可达性成为预测目标而非事后过滤器；(2) 查询地理目标注意力使用实时查询和位置作为双重目标聚合历史行为，同时将每个行为自身的地理位置编码为其注意力键；(3) GMPO（组边际策略优化）使用去重组奖励和GRPO内的边际优势重写优势，避免辅助多样性目标。在轻量级的0.1B骨干网络上部署在线，TS-GEAR在淘宝商家的搜索广告流程中每天处理超过1.5亿次查询，在HitRate和地理有效性方面持续优于最先进的生成式检索方法，并在广告展示量和广告收入上分别实现了3.8%和4.2%的增长。

articles.title: Lost in Rounding: bf16 Recurrent State Makes Hybrid Reasoning Models Think Longer
articles.abstract: Hybrid reasoning models interleave attention with recurrent mixers such as Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet, whose state is cached between decoding steps. Prior work showed that storing this state in FP16 or INT8 with round-to-nearest (RTN) makes Mamba-2 and GDN hybrids more verbose, and that stochastic rounding (SR) fixes it. We study the other 16-bit format that serving engines expose, bf16, on six open hybrid reasoning models and 590 competition-math problems. With bf16 RTN state, five of six models reason longer (geometric-mean length 1.07x to 1.27x; also under greedy decoding in the two models tested) and hit the 32K token cap more often. On Qwen3.5-9B, cap hits rise from 118 to 223 and accuracy falls from 85.6% to 70.8%. On LiveCodeBench, both models tested also reason longer and lose 12.6 and 13.4 points of pass@1. Rerunning the capped items with a 128K budget halves the accuracy gap but does not close it (93.6% vs. 86.6%): bf16 runs that never finish are twice as common, and 85% of them are exact repetition loops. On Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, by contrast, 30 of 31 extra caps finish at 128K, so the cost there is mostly extra tokens (exploratory). Same-width bf16 SR removes the length increase in four of five affected models, restores Qwen3.5-9B to 87.6% and brings code length and pass@1 near FP32 levels, so the failure is mostly rounding bias, not missing resolution. With an integer-hash random generator, SR on Qwen3.5-9B matches FP32 on cap hits and accuracy (113 vs. 118; 85.6% for both) at the memory and decoding speed of bf16 RTN. In the Nemotron-Nano-v2 lineage, SR on 25% of heads (an intermediate-decay band) removes the effect, while random heads and the top teacher-forced-KL octiles do not; in Nemotron-3 and Qwen3.5-9B the effect is spread across heads. We recommend that evaluations of hybrid models report the state dtype, cap rate and output length alongside accuracy.
articles.titleCn: 在舍入中迷失：bf16循环状态使混合推理模型认为需要更长时间
articles.abstractCn: 混合推理模型交替使用注意力机制与循环混合器（如Mamba-2和Gated DeltaNet），其状态在解码步骤之间被缓存。先前研究表明，使用FP16或INT8并以最近取整（RTN）方式存储该状态会使Mamba-2和GDN混合模型更加冗长，而随机舍入（SR）可以解决这个问题。我们研究了服务端提供的另一种16位格式bf16，在六个开放混合推理模型和590个竞赛数学问题上进行了研究。使用bf16 RTN状态时，六个模型中有五个推理时间更长（几何平均长度增加1.07倍至1.27倍；在两个测试模型中，在贪婪解码下也是如此），并且更频繁地达到32K token限制。在Qwen3.5-9B上，限制次数从118增加到223，准确率从85.6%下降到70.8%。在LiveCodeBench上，两个测试模型推理时间也变长，并且pass@1指标分别损失了12.6和13.4分。重新运行限制项，使用128K预算将准确率差距减半，但并未完全消除（93.6% vs. 86.6%）：bf16运行未完成的次数增加了一倍，其中85%是精确重复循环。相比之下，在Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2上，31个额外限制中有30个在128K预算下完成，因此这里的成本主要是额外token（探索性）。相同位宽的bf16 SR消除了四个受影响模型中的长度增加，将Qwen3.5-9B恢复到87.6%，并将代码长度和pass@1指标接近FP32水平，因此失败主要是舍入偏差，而非分辨率缺失。使用整数哈希随机生成器，Qwen3.5-9B上的SR在限制次数和准确率上与FP32相当（113 vs. 118；两者均为85.6%），且内存和解码速度与bf16 RTN相同。在Nemotron-Nano-v2系列中，25%的头部（中间衰减带）的SR消除了该效应，而随机头部和顶部教师强制KL八分位数则没有；在Nemotron-3和Qwen3.5-9B上，该效应分布在多个头部中。我们建议混合模型的评估报告应同时提供状态数据类型、限制率和输出长度，以及准确率。

articles.title: OGDA: Ontology-Grounded Data Agents for Reliable Analysis over Heterogeneous Data Lakes
articles.abstract: Full-pipeline data analysis over real-world data lakes requires LLM agents to locate and integrate information across large collections of tables with different schemas. Existing data agents follow task-specific exploration, which exhausts the context window in massive lakes. As the context fills, the agent's reasoning degrades, leading it to locate and process incorrect data files. These errors propagate into the final answer. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Ontology-Grounded Data Agent (OGDA), which utilizes a compact ontology to reduce exploration overhead and constrain data processing. OGDA constructs the ontology through agentic hypothesis testing. At each step, a proposer agent induces schemas, concepts, and relations from raw sources, and a verifier checks each proposal against the underlying data. During task execution, the ontology serves as a representation of the data lake for the agent to explore. Every data-processing action is constrained by a task graph, which the agent can extend only after observing the semantic meaning of the data. Across KramaBench and DiscoveryBench with three LLM backbones, OGDA outperforms the strongest baselines by up to 10.82 points. These results suggest that explicitly modeling the data lake is a key step toward reliable end-to-end data agents.
articles.titleCn: OGDA：基于本体的异构数据湖可靠分析数据代理
articles.abstractCn: 全流程真实世界数据湖分析需要大型语言模型代理在不同架构的表格集合中定位并整合信息。现有数据代理遵循特定任务探索，在大型数据湖中耗尽上下文窗口。随着上下文填充，代理的推理能力下降，导致其定位和处理错误的数据文件，这些错误会传播到最终答案中。为克服这些限制，我们引入本体 grounding 数据代理（OGDA），该代理利用紧凑的本体来降低探索开销并约束数据处理。OGDA通过代理假设测试构建本体。每一步，提议代理从原始数据源中诱导架构、概念和关系，验证代理则将每个提议与底层数据进行比对。在任务执行过程中，本体作为代理探索的数据湖表示。每个数据处理操作都受任务图约束，代理只有在观察到数据的语义含义后才能扩展任务图。在KramaBench和DiscoveryBench三个大型语言模型主干上，OGDA比最强基线高出10.82分。这些结果表明，显式建模数据湖是构建可靠端到端数据代理的关键步骤。

articles.title: SadaqahStories: A Verified English-Arabic Corpus of Charity Stories for Children, with an Audit of Errors in AI-Drafted Religious Narratives
articles.abstract: We present SadaqahStories, a parallel English-Arabic corpus of 41 illustrated four-page stories about charitable giving in Islam (Sadaqah, Zakat and Waqf), written for readers aged 7 to 18. The stories were first drafted with large language model (LLM) assistance, then audited against hadith collections, Qur'an references and historical sources, and finally rewritten for children and signed off by an Islamic scholar. Every story carries an evidence label and links to its sources. We release all three versions of each story (AI-assisted draft, audited text, final child-oriented text) together with the correction log, so the corpus can be used to study how AI drafts of religious and historical content go wrong. The audit found substantive errors in 39 of the 41 drafts. The most frequent were unsupported specific details (dates, figures, prices, names), invented quotations, institutions or anecdotes, and conflation of separate events or people; six drafts contained errors in the wording, grading or ruling of a religious text. Rewriting cut the estimated Flesch-Kincaid grade of the English text from 14.0 to 6.1. We also release an 81-entry charity lexicon covering Modern Standard Arabic and Qatari Arabic, and describe the free, account-free website that serves the corpus (https://sadaqahjourney.com).
articles.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Data and code: https://github.com/wajdiz/sadaqahjourney Website: https://sadaqahjourney.com
articles.titleCn: 善行故事：儿童慈善故事英语-阿拉伯语验证语料库，包含AI起草宗教叙事中的错误审计
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了SadaqahStories，一个包含41个配有插图的四页英文-阿拉伯语平行语料库，内容关于伊斯兰教中的慈善行为（包括施舍Sadaqah、天课Zakat和瓦克夫Waqf），面向7至18岁的读者。这些故事最初在大型语言模型（LLM）的帮助下草拟，然后对照圣训集、古兰经引用和历史资料进行审核，最后为儿童改写并由伊斯兰学者审定。每个故事都带有证据标签，并链接到其来源。我们发布了每个故事的三个版本（AI辅助草稿、审核文本、最终面向儿童文本）以及修正日志，以便语料库可用于研究AI草拟宗教和历史内容的错误方式。审核发现41份草稿中有39份存在实质性错误。最常见的是未经证实的具体细节（日期、数字、价格、名称）、编造的引言、机构或轶事，以及混淆独立事件或人物；其中6份草稿在宗教文本的措辞、分级或裁决方面存在错误。改写将英文文本的Flesch-Kincaid年级从14.0降至6.1。我们还发布了一个包含81个词条的慈善词汇表，涵盖现代标准阿拉伯语和卡塔尔阿拉伯语，并描述了服务该语料库的免费、无需账号的网站（https://sadaqahjourney.com）。

articles.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
articles.abstract: Long-term memory lets LLM agents personalize, stay consistent, and reuse what worked before. Parametric memories need training, consolidation can lose details for good, and keeping every record leaves a growing store to search. We present MIRIX-2.0, a multi-agent memory system designed to be practical, accurate, and efficient at once. It is the most accurate of the compared systems on four of five QA benchmarks. It reaches 91.4% on LoCoMo and 72.6% on LongMemEval-S, where it leads the strongest baseline by 14.3 points, and with AutoDream disabled it gains 31.0 and 22.0 points over HyperMem on single-hop and multi-hop document QA. As procedural memory, it yields the highest mean success among the compared memory methods on ALFWorld and WebShop and reaches 49.2% on MetaClaw-Bench, against 44.0% for MetaClaw's skill library. Six typed memory agents keep complete records as the system of record, and a provenance hypergraph indexes episodic and semantic records with n-ary frames that cite their rows. Retrieval runs under explicit budgets, so the evidence a question inspects does not grow with the history. AutoDream merges duplicate anchors outside the write path without rewriting any record, and it distills task sessions into skills. With AutoDream disabled, MIRIX-2.0 answers faster than HyperMem on all five timed benchmarks. It needs no fine-tuning, runs with closed and open models, and its code is public.
articles.titleCn: MIRIX-2.0：多智能体记忆系统
articles.abstractCn: 长期记忆使大语言模型代理能够个性化、保持一致性并重用以往有效的方法。参数化记忆需要训练，巩固过程可能永久丢失细节，而保存所有记录则会导致不断增长的可搜索存储库。我们提出了MIRIX-2.0，这是一个兼顾实用性、准确性和高效性的多代理记忆系统。在五个问答基准测试中的四个上，它是最准确的系统。在LoCoMo上达到91.4%，在LongMemEval-S上达到72.6%，比最强的基线领先14.3分，并且在不启用AutoDream的情况下，在单跳和多跳文档问答上分别比HyperMem提升31.0和22.0分。作为程序记忆，它在ALFWorld和WebShop上与其他记忆方法相比取得最高平均成功率，并在MetaClaw-Bench上达到49.2%，而MetaClaw技能库为44.0%。六个类型化的记忆代理作为系统记录保存完整记录，一个已验证的溯源超图使用n元框架索引情景和语义记录，并引用其行。检索操作在显式预算下运行，因此问题检查的证据不会随着历史记录增长。AutoDream在不重写任何记录的情况下，在写入路径外合并重复锚点，并将任务会话提炼成技能。在不启用AutoDream的情况下，MIRIX-2.0在所有五个计时基准测试上都比HyperMem回答得更快。它无需微调，支持封闭和开放模型，其代码是公开的。

articles.title: Translating KV Caches Between Hybrid-Attention Language Models: MLA Latents, Linear-Attention States and Sparse-Attention Indexers
articles.abstract: A model that takes over another model's conversation must normally re-read the whole history; a text hand-off shortens the re-read only by dropping content. KV-cache translation instead maps the source's cache into the target's own format, so the target continues from the full context without re-reading it. It works for grouped-query attention (GQA), but open-weights frontier models now cache compressed latents (MLA), sparse-attention indexer keys and fixed-size linear-attention states. We replicate KV-Lingo on a GQA pair and then give, for each of these objects, where to capture and inject it and a mechanism that reaches native quality. We study two hybrid pairs at 16-48B scale in both directions, Kimi-VL-A3B - Kimi-Linear-48B (MLA - MLA + Kimi Delta Attention) and Qwen3.5-27B - Qwen3.8-27B (Gated DeltaNet hybrids), plus a sparse-attention target (Qwen3.8-27B - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next). MLA latents translate with token-wise linear maps; recurrent states are copied with a closed-form correction or synthesised by replaying the target's own recurrence. Exact long-range recall needs token identity: decoding token ids from the source's layer-0 MLA latent raises needle recall from 0.09 to 0.99 at 2-32K and to 0.83-1.00 at 64K, eight times the longest training prompt. The hybrid full-MLA direction is within the paired confidence interval of native quality on every task metric, and same-shape GDN hybrids reach the native level in both directions (apart from 6% refusals inherited from the source), with time to first token 18.7 and 46.8 times shorter than a re-read at 64K tokens. Segment-wise multi-turn transfer stays at the re-prefill level; naive re-translation collapses. On the sparse-attention target, predicted indexer keys recall the needle as well as the target's own keys (one seed). We state as a hypothesis how the recipes transfer to 300B+ hybrid flagships.
articles.titleCn: 在混合注意力语言模型之间转换KV缓存：MLA隐状态、线性注意力状态和稀疏注意力索引器
articles.abstractCn: 一个接管另一个模型对话的模型通常必须重新读取整个对话历史；文本交接仅通过丢弃内容来缩短重新读取时间。KV缓存翻译则将源缓存映射为目标自己的格式，因此目标能够从完整上下文中继续，而无需重新读取。这种方法适用于分组查询注意力（GQA），但当前的开放权重边界模型缓存了压缩的潜空间（MLA）、稀疏注意力索引器键和固定大小的线性注意力状态。我们在GQA对上复制了KV-Lingo，并为这些对象中的每一个提供了捕获和注入的位置以及达到原生质量的机制。我们研究了两个双向16-48B规模的混合对：Kimi-VL-A3B - Kimi-Linear-48B（MLA - MLA + Kimi Delta注意力）和Qwen3.5-27B - Qwen3.8-27B（门控DeltaNet混合），以及一个稀疏注意力目标（Qwen3.8-27B - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）。MLA潜空间通过逐token线性映射进行转换；循环状态通过闭式校正复制或通过重放目标的自身循环合成。精确的长距离回忆需要token身份：从源层的MLA潜空间解码token ID将针回忆率从0.09提高到2-32K时的0.99，以及64K时的0.83-1.00，是训练提示最长长度的八倍。混合全MLA方向在所有任务指标上都在原生质量的配对置信区间内，相同形状的GDN混合在两个方向上都达到原生水平（除了继承自源的6%拒绝率），首次token生成时间比64K token的重新读取快18.7和46.8倍。分段多轮转移保持在重新填充水平；朴素重翻译会崩溃。在稀疏注意力目标上，预测的索引器键与目标自己的键一样能回忆起针（一个种子）。我们提出假设，说明这些配方如何转移到300B+混合旗舰。

articles.title: SMO: Compiling Natural Language Skills into Graphs of Reusable State-Move-Outcome Bricks
articles.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on reusable natural-language skills, yet growing skill collections remain accumulations of isolated text artifacts that are difficult to compare, deduplicate, and compose. We argue that the reusable content of a skill lies not in its surface wording but in its procedural transitions: which operation to execute under a given state and which observable outcome to produce. Based on this observation, we propose State-Move-Outcome (SMO), a compilation-like framework that decomposes raw skills into reusable procedural bricks and organizes admitted bricks as an externalized symbolic structure. When compiling a skill, SMO first retrieves and composes existing bricks, dynamically connects them through Outcome-to-State conditions, and creates a candidate brick only for an uncovered procedure; the candidate becomes reusable only after validation and admission. Experiments on SkillsBench v1.1 demonstrate that SMO represents 232 rawSkills from 87 underlying tasks with 95 shared bricks, reducing the corresponding skill representations from 366,472 to 149,154 tokens--a $\mathbf{59.3}\times$ reduction and $\mathbf{2.46}\times$ compression. Across 232 skill-conditioned evaluation instances, SMO raises the average task score from $\mathbf{0.6379}$ to $\mathbf{0.7478}$ and increases 5/5 Pass instances from $\mathbf{138}$ to $\mathbf{164}$, while matching or outperforming rawSkill on $\mathbf{208}$ of $\mathbf{232}$ instances. It also reduces average runtime token consumption by $\mathbf{38.38\%}$. These results show that compiling natural-language skills into shared procedural units can jointly improve skill reuse, representation efficiency, and downstream execution.
articles.titleCn: SMO：将自然语言技能编译为可重用的状态-动作-结果积木图
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地依赖可复用的自然语言技能，然而不断增长的技能集合仍然是难以比较、去重和组合的孤立文本片段的累积。我们认为，技能的可复用内容不在于其表面措辞，而在于其程序性转换：在给定状态下应执行的操作以及应产生的可观察结果。基于这一观察，我们提出了状态-动作-结果（SMO）框架，该框架类似于编译过程，将原始技能分解为可复用的程序性积木，并将接受的积木组织为外部化的符号结构。在编译技能时，SMO首先检索并组合现有积木，通过结果到状态的条件动态连接它们，并且只为未覆盖的程序创建候选积木；候选积木只有在经过验证和接受后才能变得可复用。在SkillsBench v1.1上的实验表明，SMO用95个共享积木表示了87个底层任务中的232个原始技能，将相应的技能表示从366,472个token减少到149,154个token——减少了$\mathbf{59.3}$倍，压缩了$\mathbf{2.46}$倍。在232个技能条件下的评估实例中，SMO将平均任务分数从$\mathbf{0.6379}$提高到$\mathbf{0.7478}$，将5/5通过实例从$\mathbf{138}$增加到$\mathbf{164}$，同时在$\mathbf{232}$个实例中的$\mathbf{208}$个实例上匹配或优于原始技能，同时将平均运行时token消耗减少了$\mathbf{38.38\%}$。这些结果表明，将自然语言技能编译为共享的程序性单元可以共同提高技能复用性、表示效率和下游执行能力。

articles.title: A generalized transition framework for identifying reduction domains in non-binary constituency parsing
articles.abstract: Direct non-binary constituency parsing must identify an ordered sequence of children at each phrase-level reduction. We extend our earlier delimiter-guided bottom-up construction to a common calculus for top-down, in-order, and bottom-up parsing. At reduction, the rightmost delimiter marks the left boundary, the nonterminal marker supplies the mother label, and the completed items in the delimited segment determine the children and arity. We use a stack invariant to prove soundness and completeness and derive the exact length of the static oracle's action sequence. A projection-and-lifting theorem shows that each delimiter-guided system and its canonical counterpart generate the same set of trees under both the structural and grammar-licensed transition relations. In controlled experiments on PTB and CTB, the delimiter-guided parsers achieve similar labeled accuracy to their canonical counterparts across all traversal orders. For bottom-up parsing, delimiter guidance reduces the number of action classes and increases the number of supervised decisions per tree.
articles.titleCn: 用于在非二元句法分析中识别约简域的通用转换框架
articles.abstractCn: 直接非二元短语结构分析必须在每个短语级归约中识别一个有序的子节点序列。我们将早期基于分隔符的自顶向下构建扩展为一个适用于自顶向下、中序遍历和自底向上分析的通用演算。在归约时，最右边的分隔符标记左侧边界，非终端标记提供母节点标签，而分隔段中的已完成项决定子节点和元数。我们使用栈不变式来证明正确性和完备性，并推导出静态预言机动作序列的精确长度。一个投影和提升定理表明，每个基于分隔符的系统及其规范对应系统在结构转换关系和语法许可转换关系下生成相同的树集。在PTB和CTB的控制实验中，基于分隔符的分析器在所有遍历顺序下均实现了与规范对应系统相似的标记准确率。对于自底向上分析，基于分隔符的指导减少了动作类别数量，并增加了每棵树上的监督决策数量。

articles.title: Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization
articles.abstract: Many real-world applications require language models to internalize knowledge that was absent from pretraining, to incorporate continually updated facts, or to learn new domain skills. Self-distillation has emerged as a natural approach for this task. A model conditioned on the source material acts as the teacher, and an unconditioned student is trained to reproduce the teacher's behavior closed-book. We propose Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD), an efficient per-token mixed-policy method for self-distillation. The student generates each rollout by default, while the teacher intervenes only at positions where its next-token distribution substantially diverges from the student's. Unlike off-policy distillation with teacher-generated prefixes, this design keeps training rollouts close to the student's test-time behavior, while avoiding the low-signal states that fully on-policy rollouts drift into. In effect, SSD lets the teacher steer the rollout exactly where the privileged context changes the prediction. On three closed-book QA benchmarks measuring fact recall, knowledge updates, and skill acquisition, SSD nearly matches on-policy distillation while using 38-69% fewer supervised tokens and consistently outperforms off-policy distillation on the held-out test set. On a forgetting stress test, SSD retains the most general capability while also achieving the best in-domain accuracy and using less supervision than the on-policy baseline. Overall, SSD establishes a new accuracy-efficiency-forgetting Pareto frontier for self-distillation.
