articles.titleCn: 推测性自蒸馏能够实现高效知识内化
articles.abstractCn: 许多实际应用需要语言模型内化预训练中缺失的知识，整合持续更新的事实，或学习新的领域技能。自我蒸馏（Self-distillation）已成为解决这一任务的自然方法。一个基于源材料的模型充当教师，而无条件的学生则被训练在闭卷状态下复制教师的行为。我们提出了推测性自我蒸馏（Speculative Self-Distillation，SSD），这是一种高效的按token混合策略的自我蒸馏方法。学生默认生成每个 rollout，而教师仅在下一个token分布与学生的显著偏离时进行干预。与使用教师生成的prefix的离线策略蒸馏不同，这种设计使训练 rollout 接近学生在测试时的行为，同时避免了全策略 rollout 漂移到的低信号状态。实际上，SSD 让教师引导 rollout 精确到特权上下文改变预测的位置。在三个衡量事实回忆、知识更新和技能获取的闭卷问答基准测试中，SSD 在使用 38-69% 更少的监督token的情况下，几乎与全策略蒸馏相当，并在保留测试集上持续优于离线策略蒸馏。在遗忘压力测试中，SSD 保留了最通用的能力，同时实现了最佳的领域准确率，并比全策略基线使用了更少的监督。总体而言，SSD 为自我蒸馏建立了新的准确率-效率-遗忘的帕累托前沿。

articles.title: Robust Domain-Mixture Scheduling for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges the capabilities of multiple domain-expert teachers, such as mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following, into a single compact student. Since all domains share a limited training budget, how to allocate it across domains directly determines the quality of distillation. Existing methods allocate the budget by each domain's learning progress, but offer no guarantee for lagging domains. We therefore introduce distributionally robust optimization (DRO) into MOPD to prioritize the worst-performing domain. However, the per-domain training signals are estimated from a few rollouts and are inherently noisy, so directly applying DRO mistakes noise for the worst case, lets occasional spikes hijack the budget, and protects inherently hard domains rather than truly regressing ones. To address these issues, we propose RDS-MOPD, which keeps the DRO objective and redesigns its three parts: it shifts the allocation only when differences clearly exceed the noise, bounds the influence of any single anomaly, and defines the worst case as the regression from each domain's own best level, all with theoretical guarantees. Experiments show that RDS-MOPD outperforms recent competing methods and ranks first on most mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction-following benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 针对多导师策略蒸馏的鲁棒领域混合调度
articles.abstractCn: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将多个领域专家教师的能力，如数学推理、代码生成和指令遵循，整合到一个紧凑的学生模型中。由于所有领域共享有限的训练预算，如何分配预算直接决定了蒸馏的质量。现有方法根据每个领域的学习进度分配预算，但对落后领域没有保证。因此，我们将分布鲁棒优化（DRO）引入MOPD，以优先考虑表现最差的领域。然而，每个领域的训练信号是从少量运行中估计的，并且本质上具有噪声，因此直接应用DRO会将噪声误认为最坏情况，让偶尔的峰值窃取预算，并保护本质上困难的领域而非真正需要退化的领域。为解决这些问题，我们提出了RDS-MOPD，它保留DRO目标并重新设计了其三个部分：仅在差异明显超过噪声时才进行分配转移，限制任何单个异常的影响，并将最坏情况定义为每个领域从自身最佳水平开始的退化，所有这些都具有理论保证。实验表明，RDS-MOPD优于最近竞争方法，并在大多数数学推理、代码生成和指令遵循基准测试中排名第一。

articles.title: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
articles.abstract: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.
articles.titleCn: Infrathon：针对现实世界、长时程AI基础设施优化的语言代理基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 在这项工作中，我们研究了前沿智能体是否能够在长期范围内持续改进现实世界的AI基础设施。我们引入了Infrathon，这是一个涵盖不同层级、多样化的长期AI基础设施优化任务的基准。我们在24小时预算下对六个模型进行了150次运行，总计超过10,000 GPU小时。我们的结果表明，模型排名随评估时间范围的变化而变化，而150次运行中有135次在预算的后半段实现了进一步改进。这些发现表明，较短的评估可能会忽略优化收益和模型相对性能的变化。我们还发现，智能体可以找到优于人类设计的基线的解决方案：Claude Opus 5.5将人类设计的Quant-VideoGen编解码器的平均KV缓存压缩率从6.82%提高到19.86%。对智能体轨迹的分析确定了任务违规、不可靠的测试和过早完成作为持续改进的障碍。总的来说，我们的Infrathon框架为构建长期任务、评估前沿智能体和发现良好的基础设施解决方案提供了资源。

articles.title: EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
articles.abstract: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. We present EmoHarness, which runs such a model, the frozen student, inside a harness: the prompts, settings, and verification code around its calls. A human-written starting harness, the scaffold, numbers the student's visual observations, transcript, and prosody descriptions as citable evidence and has the student weigh candidate emotions against it. In Meta-Harness Evolving (MHE), a stronger LLM, the Builder, reads the student's errors and execution traces offline and edits the harness; static checks and validation gates decide which edits are kept, and the Builder never sees evaluation items. On 5,507 MME-Emotion items, EmoHarness raises task-macro Recognition by 7.6-13.4 points over a single video-only call for all four students and both Builders. Transcripts and prosody descriptions supply most of this boost (+5.38 to +10.71); the scaffold changes the audio-augmented call by -0.79 to +2.54, partly through extra multi-label predictions, and evolved edits add at most +0.95, although no evolved increment survives Holm correction. The harness's emotion context also transfers to IntentQA, with small gains for three of four students, none of which survives correction. EmoHarness thus boosts small multimodal students chiefly by supplying and organizing audio-derived evidence.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://emo-harness.github.io. Code: https://github.com/Emo-Harness/EmoHarness
articles.titleCn: EmoHarness：通过元哈桑进化提升多模态情感理解
articles.abstractCn: 小型多模态模型在词语、声音和视觉线索冲突时可能会误判情绪。我们提出了EmoHarness，它将此类模型（冻结的学生模型）置于一个“约束框架”中运行：该框架围绕模型的调用提供了提示、设置和验证码。一个由人类编写的初始框架（骨架），将学生的视觉观察、转录文本和韵律描述编号为可引用的证据，并让学生根据这些证据权衡候选情绪。在元框架进化（MHE）中，一个更强的LLM（构建者）会离线读取学生模型的错误和执行轨迹，并编辑框架；静态检查和验证门决定保留哪些编辑，且构建者永远不会看到评估项。在5,507个MME-Emotion数据项上，EmoHarness在所有四个学生和两个构建者中，通过单个视频调用将任务宏观识别率提高了7.6-13.4分。转录文本和韵律描述提供了大部分提升（+5.38至+10.71）；骨架变化通过额外的多标签预测将音频增强调用降低了-0.79至+2.54；进化编辑最多增加+0.95，尽管没有进化增量通过Holm校正。框架的情绪上下文也能迁移到IntentQA，对四个学生中的三个有微小提升，但均未通过校正。因此，EmoHarness主要通过提供和组织音频衍生证据来提升小型多模态学生。

articles.title: When Audio and Video Mislead: Evaluating Multimodal AI for Conversational Emotion Recognition
articles.abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation (MERC) combines lexical, acoustic, visual and conversational cues, but accepting audio and video does not establish their effective or robust use. We audit off-the-shelf Omni models while holding the target transcript and prior textual context fixed and adding, removing or replacing target audio and video. In the primary evaluation of Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, Baichuan-Omni-1.5 and MiniCPM-o 2.6 on MELD and the full five-session six-class IEMOCAP set, T+A improves Accuracy in all six model-dataset pairs, with four gains significant after false discovery rate (FDR) correction. Across three source mappings, unrelated A/V (RandA/V) lowers Accuracy relative to Full in all 18 comparisons; all 18 remain significant under dialogue-cluster inference and BH-FDR correction, both on common-valid pairs and when invalid/OOM outcomes are treated as incorrect. Comparisons with modality-omission baselines further distinguish replacement penalties from mismatch-specific harm. A Qwen/MELD case study finds significantly greater gold-vs-best-candidate margin recovery in Late than Early or Middle under decision-query audio knockout, relative to an edge-count-matched Video-Sham control, using Holm-corrected tests. These results distinguish genuine-modality benefit from sensitivity and vulnerability to misleading input.
articles.comment: 40 pages, 3 figures, 24 tables. Full version with appendices of a paper accepted at AICompS 2026 (Springer CCIS). Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23970406
articles.titleCn: 当音视频误导时：评估多模态AI在对话情绪识别中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 对话中的多模态情感识别（MERC）结合了词汇、声学、视觉和对话线索，但仅接受音频和视频并不能保证其有效或稳健的使用。我们保持目标文本和先验文本上下文固定，同时添加、删除或替换目标音频和视频，对现成的Omni模型进行审计。在MELD和完整的五会话六类IEMOCAP数据集上对Qwen2.5-Omni-7B、Baichuan-Omni-1.5和MiniCPM-o 2.6进行初步评估时，T+A在所有六组模型-数据集中均提高了准确率，其中四项提升在错误发现率（FDR）校正后具有显著性。在三种源映射中，无关的A/V（RandA/V）在所有18次比较中均降低了准确率，且在对话聚类推理和BH-FDR校正下，这18次比较在公共有效对和无效/OOM结果视为错误时均保持显著性。与模态省略基线的比较进一步区分了替换惩罚与特定不匹配损害。一项Qwen/MELD案例研究发现在决策查询音频剔除下，晚期相比早期或中期在金标与最佳候选之间的差距恢复显著更大，相对于边缘计数匹配的视频-假对照，使用Holm校正测试。这些结果区分了真实模态收益与对误导性输入的敏感性和脆弱性。

articles.title: CHO-Bench: How Do Context Hints Affect Ad Rankings in LLM Advertising?
articles.abstract: LLM advertising selects advertisements based on user conversations, where user needs may extend beyond explicit product searches. ChatGPT Ads allows advertisers to provide natural-language context hints describing what they offer, who may find it useful, and when it may be useful, as additional information for ranking advertisements across diverse user conversations. However, how to effectively construct these hints remains unclear. We formulate Context Hint Optimization (CHO) as the problem of constructing context hints to improve an advertisement's ranking under a given budget. Drawing on established marketing frameworks, we develop seven context hint generation strategies covering What, Who, and When, along with a Unified strategy that combines all seven dimensions. We introduce CHO-Bench and conduct over 1.19 million paired evaluations across five datasets using embedding-based and LLM-based rankers. Our results show that context hints improve advertisement rankings under the evaluated offline rankers. While individual strategies achieve similar average gains and Unified offers no consistent advantage, strategy differences become more pronounced under specific generation-ranking configurations, with embedding-based and LLM-based rankers favoring different information dimensions. Increasing the hint budget further improves rankings with diminishing marginal gains. These findings establish an offline benchmark for studying ad-side ranking optimization in LLM advertising and highlight opportunities for model-specific hint selection and budget-aware generation and aggregation.
articles.titleCn: CHO-Bench：上下文提示如何影响大型语言模型广告中的广告排名？
articles.abstractCn: LLM广告根据用户对话选择广告，而用户需求可能超出显式的产品搜索范围。ChatGPT广告允许广告商提供描述其提供内容、谁可能觉得有用以及何时可能有用的自然语言上下文提示，作为跨不同用户对话中广告排名的附加信息。然而，如何有效构建这些提示尚不明确。我们将上下文提示优化（CHO）定义为在给定预算下构建上下文提示以提升广告排名的问题。借鉴成熟的营销框架，我们开发了涵盖What、Who和When的七种上下文提示生成策略，以及结合所有七个维度的统一策略。我们引入CHO-Bench，并使用基于嵌入和基于LLM的排序器在五个数据集上进行了超过119万次配对评估。结果表明，在评估的离线排序器中，上下文提示提升了广告排名。虽然单个策略实现了相似的均值增益，统一策略并未提供持续优势，但在特定的生成-排序配置下，策略差异更为显著，基于嵌入和基于LLM的排序器倾向于不同的信息维度。增加提示预算进一步提升了排名，但边际收益递减。这些发现为研究LLM广告中的广告端排序优化建立了离线基准，并突出了针对模型特定提示选择和预算感知生成与聚合的机会。

articles.title: BharatSynthQA: A Context-Grounded Question Answering Dataset on Indian Temples and Religious Heritage
articles.abstract: India's temples and other places of worship are among its richest repositories of cultural heritage, bringing together religious tradition, history, architecture, and art. Due to the widespread curiosity, people increasingly turn to Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistants for information about them. Current models are rarely trained or evaluated on this domain. We present BharatSynthQA, a passage grounded question answering (QA) dataset focused on Indian temples, which also covers other religious sites connected to them. Our pipeline crawls Wikipedia from topics seeded by authentic heritage sources, filters articles for topical relevance, and locations in India. Further it generates Boolean, factoid, and explanatory QA pairs with a fewshot prompted LLM. An LLM judge filters the pairs on answer correctness, retaining 98,677 of 131,494 generated pairs. Additionally, 300 human-annotated pairs are released separately as a reference set. Human evaluation of the subsample of this dataset showed 89.83% of the questions were formed correctly. Benchmarking five current LLMs shows that factoid token F1 is only 0.18-0.30 without the source passage but 0.73-0.77 with it, indicating that this domain is poorly captured in model knowledge. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/theshivam7/bharatsynth-qa to support research on culturally grounded QA and retrieval-augmented generation for Indian heritage.
articles.titleCn: BharatSynthQA：一个基于印度寺庙和宗教遗产的上下文相关问答数据集
articles.abstractCn: 印度的寺庙和其他宗教场所是其文化遗产中最丰富的宝库之一，汇聚了宗教传统、历史、建筑和艺术。由于广泛的兴趣，人们越来越倾向于使用人工智能（AI）助手来获取相关信息。目前的模型很少在这个领域进行训练或评估。我们提出了BharatSynthQA，这是一个以印度寺庙为重点的文本依据问答（QA）数据集，同时也涵盖了与之相关的其他宗教场所。我们的工作流程从真实文化遗产来源提供的种子主题中爬取维基百科，筛选出与主题相关且位于印度的文章。进一步地，我们使用少量提示的LLM生成布尔型、事实型和解释型QA对。一个LLM裁判根据答案的正确性筛选这些对，保留了131,494个生成的对中的98,677个。此外，我们还单独发布了300个人工标注的对作为参考集。对该数据集子集的人工评估显示，89.83%的问题被正确形成。对五个当前LLM的基准测试表明，如果没有源文本，事实型token F1仅为0.18-0.30，但有源文本时则为0.73-0.77，这表明该领域在模型知识中未能得到充分捕捉。该数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/theshivam7/bharatsynth-qa获取，以支持基于文化背景的问答和文化遗产的检索增强生成研究。

articles.title: Language processing in the autistic brain: A meta-analysis of neuroimaging studies across modalities and age
articles.abstract: Language is central to social communication, which is altered in autism, and language abilities vary widely among autistic individuals. How the autistic brain processes language is central to understanding autistic communication. Yet neuroimaging studies report inconsistent findings on how autistic brain activity is altered during language processing. We synthesized 45 fMRI and PET studies (753 autistic and 777 non-autistic participants) with seed-based d mapping with permutation of subject images (SDM-PSI). We estimated autistic and non-autistic activation and their difference with meta-regressions adjusted for each study's language modality and mean age. Autistic and non-autistic brains activated a similar left-lateralized language network. Autistic brains showed reduced activity throughout the left perisylvian cortex, from the inferior frontal gyrus to the mid superior temporal gyrus and the posterior superior temporal sulcus, and increased activity in the right temporal pole. Spoken language showed a larger autistic reduction than written language in the left mid superior temporal gyrus. Adults, but not children and adolescents, showed increased autistic activity in the right superior temporal gyrus and cuneus. Autistic language processing thus relies on the typical left-lateralized network but shows reduced leftward lateralization.
articles.titleCn: 自闭症大脑中的语言处理：跨模态和年龄的神经影像学研究元分析
articles.abstractCn: 语言是社会交流的核心，而在自闭症中，这种交流方式会发生改变，且自闭症个体的语言能力差异很大。理解自闭症如何处理语言，对于理解自闭症交流至关重要。然而，神经影像学研究在自闭症大脑在语言处理过程中的活动变化方面报告了不一致的结果。我们使用基于种子图的置换主体图像的元分析（SDM-PSI）综合了45项fMRI和PET研究（753名自闭症个体和777名非自闭症个体）。我们通过元回归估计了自闭症和非自闭症个体的激活及其差异，并调整了每项研究的语言模式和平均年龄。自闭症和非自闭症大脑激活了相似的左侧偏侧化语言网络。自闭症大脑在整个左侧皮层下区域显示出活动减少，从额下回到中上颞回和后上颞沟，并在右侧颞极显示出活动增加。口语在左侧中上颞回显示出比书面语更大的自闭症活动减少。成年人（但不是儿童和青少年）在右侧上颞回和楔前叶显示出增加的自闭症活动。因此，自闭症语言处理依赖于典型的左侧偏侧化网络，但显示出左侧偏侧化减少。

articles.title: Spectral Unlearning: Transformer Structure-Preserving Updates for Language Models
articles.abstract: Machine unlearning in large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specific learned knowledge, capabilities, or behaviors while preserving model utility. Existing methods have mostly focused on the design of unlearning objectives, while largely overlooking the intrinsic matrix structure of transformer weights. In particular, standard optimizers operate on independent scalar coordinates, thereby ignoring this matrix structure. We propose spectral unlearning, an update framework that combines standard unlearning objectives with matrix-structured optimization. We show that the spectral update corresponds to the steepest-descent direction for transformers composed of linear layers with normalized inputs and outputs. Our approach is applied on top of existing unlearning methods and evaluated across complementary axes of memorization, privacy, and utility, summarized via their harmonic mean. Spectral unlearning consistently outperforms a broad range of baselines and closes most of the gap to a retain-trained reference. Code is available at https://github.com/unlearn-ml/spectral-unlearning/.
articles.titleCn: 光谱重学：Transformer结构保持更新用于语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）中的机器卸载旨在移除特定的学习知识、能力或行为，同时保留模型的效用。现有方法主要集中于卸载目标的设计，而很大程度上忽略了转换器权重的内在矩阵结构。特别是，标准优化器在独立的标量坐标上操作，从而忽略了这种矩阵结构。我们提出了谱卸载，这是一个结合标准卸载目标与矩阵结构优化的更新框架。我们证明，谱更新对应于由具有归一化输入和输出的线性层组成的转换器的最速下降方向。我们的方法建立在现有的卸载方法之上，并在记忆、隐私和效用等互补轴上进行了评估，这些轴通过它们的调和平均数进行总结。谱卸载始终优于广泛的基线，并缩小了与保留训练参考的大部分差距。代码可在 https://github.com/unlearn-ml/spectral-unlearning/ 获取。

articles.title: Adaptive Entropy-Sparing for Efficient Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) produce explicit chains of thought to improve transparency, but they frequently overthink, generating long yet inefficient reasoning chains that inflate computational costs and risk introducing errors. While numerous reinforcement learning methods struggle to penalize verbosity to achieve conciseness, they typically apply the penalty uniformly across lengthy sequences, which leads to credit confounding, that is, the failure to distinguish essential reasoning steps from superfluous ones. In this paper, we study a measurable proxy for this confounding: high-entropy tokens that often coincide with surface transition points where reasoning re-enters verification. Based on this insight, we propose Adaptive Entropy-Sparing (AES), which selectively spares high-entropy tokens that occur before an efficient in-group reference, while penalizing overlength high-entropy suffix tokens associated with superfluous branching. Our AES thereby navigates the suppression-exploration trade-off, reducing overthinking while preserving average reasoning accuracy. We also present an entropy-length model that motivates why local uncertainty can serve as a proxy for future reasoning cost. Across eight reasoning benchmarks, AES reduces reasoning length by up to 52.9% while increasing mean accuracy by up to 3.8% over the base models, consistently outperforming existing efficiency-oriented methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/MobiusDai/AES.
articles.titleCn: 自适应冗余熵节约高效推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过生成明确的推理链来提高透明度，但它们经常过度思考，生成冗长且低效的推理链，从而增加计算成本并引入错误风险。尽管许多强化学习方法难以通过惩罚冗长性来实现简洁性，但它们通常在整个长序列中统一应用惩罚，这导致了信用混淆问题，即无法区分关键的推理步骤与冗余步骤。在本文中，我们研究了一种可测量的信用混淆代理指标：高熵标记，这些标记通常与推理重新进入验证的表面转换点相吻合。基于这一见解，我们提出了自适应熵节约（AES）方法，该方法选择性地保留在高效内组参考之前出现的高熵标记，同时惩罚与冗余分支相关联的过长高熵后缀标记。因此，AES在抑制与探索的权衡中找到了平衡点，减少了过度思考，同时保持了平均推理准确率。我们还提出了一个熵-长度模型，解释了为什么局部不确定性可以作为未来推理成本的代理指标。在八个推理基准测试中，AES将推理长度减少了高达52.9%，同时将平均准确率提高了高达3.8%，始终优于现有的以效率为导向的方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/MobiusDai/AES获取。

articles.title: ShopMind: A Mental World Model for Personalized and Realistic E-commerce User Simulation
articles.abstract: Large language models are widely used in e-commerce user simulation, providing a foundation for understanding users and predicting human decisions. However, existing simulators still struggle to achieve both personalization and behavioral realism. Most methods predict the next action directly from interaction histories and the current context, without accounting for the evolving mental world that underlies user behavior. Theory of Mind suggests that behavior is driven by mental states, including beliefs, uncertainties, and intentions. Users may interpret the same information in distinct ways, leading to divergent behaviors, while an individual's mental state evolves through interaction and shapes subsequent actions. Ignoring this process prevents simulators from faithfully capturing individual differences and realistic behavior patterns, and undermines its effectiveness in downstream applications. To address this, we propose ShopMind, a Mental World Model for e-commerce user simulation that captures how consumers interpret shopping information and how their mental states evolve, better reflecting individual users and real-world behavior patterns. We further use behavior-mental state pairs synthesized by ShopMind to train a Mental State Reconstruction (MSR) model, which infers consumers' latent mental states from observable behavior. Experiments show that ShopMind improves personalization by 18.0% and behavioral realism by 19.6% over the strongest alternatives. Moreover, MSR improves performance on consumption value measurement and CTR prediction, showing the utility of ShopMind for understanding and predicting real user behavior.
articles.titleCn: ShopMind：用于个性化及真实电子商务用户模拟的精神世界模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在电商用户模拟中得到了广泛应用，为理解用户和预测人类决策提供了基础。然而，现有的模拟器仍难以同时实现个性化和行为真实性。大多数方法直接根据交互历史和当前上下文预测下一个动作，而没有考虑用户行为背后的不断演变的内心世界。心智理论表明，行为是由心理状态驱动的，包括信念、不确定性和意图。用户可能会以不同的方式解读相同的信息，导致行为出现分歧，而个人的心理状态通过交互演变并塑造后续行为。忽视这一过程导致模拟器无法真实地捕捉个体差异和真实的行为模式，并削弱了其在下游应用中的有效性。为此，我们提出了ShopMind，一个用于电商用户模拟的心智世界模型，它捕捉了消费者如何解读购物信息以及其心理状态的演变，更好地反映了个体用户和现实世界的行为模式。我们进一步使用ShopMind合成的行为-心理状态对来训练一个心智状态重建（MSR）模型，该模型从可观察的行为中推断消费者的潜在心理状态。实验表明，与最强的替代方案相比，ShopMind将个性化提高了18.0%，行为真实性提高了19.6%。此外，MSR在消费价值测量和点击率预测方面的表现得到提升，显示了ShopMind在理解和预测真实用户行为方面的实用性。

articles.title: When Answer Decodability Is Not a Decision: Separating Final-Answer and Imminent-Emission Signals in Chain-of-Thought
articles.abstract: Answer probes applied to chain-of-thought hidden states are often read as evidence that a language model has already decided its final response. This reading overlooks a competing signal, the candidate the model is about to mention. We introduce emission-controlled dual-target probing (ECDP), which fits the same low-rank reader family separately to the imminent mention and to the final answer at identical positions, with target-specific nulls and thresholds fixed before any fit. On correct DecisionDepth (DD) rollouts in which a distractor is mentioned before the final answer, Qwen3.5-4B decodes the next mention at .966 (null .234) but the final answer only at .221 (null .186), an emission gap of .696 [.648, .744]; Llama-3.1-8B gives .575 [.514, .632]. This pattern is not universal. In a pre-specified evaluation of Qwen3-8B with thinking enabled on held-out MMLU questions, using a full-prefix attention reader over every thinking position, both targets are decodable and the final answer is read far more strongly (mention-minus-answer lift -.398 [-.459, -.336] at layer 22 over 467 questions). Model, task, positions, and reader change together between these settings, and an attempted matched comparison on DD produced no valid statistics because the imminent-mention probe did not train reliably, so we do not identify what reverses the order. On DD, planted-signal controls show that the reader recovers an injected final-answer signal at one tenth of full dose. Answer-candidate decodability is therefore target-relative and protocol-dependent: a strong answer readout does not by itself establish when a model commits, and a probe that fails to train is not evidence that the information is absent. ECDP is a practical control for distinguishing imminent text emission from evidence of a settled decision.
articles.titleCn: 当答案可解码性并非决策：在思维链中分离最终答案与即时发射信号
articles.abstractCn: 应用于思维链隐藏状态的回答探针通常被解读为语言模型已决定最终响应的证据。这种解读忽略了另一个竞争信号——模型即将提及的候选内容。我们引入了发射控制双目标探针（ECDP），该探针将同一低秩读取器家族分别应用于即将提及的内容和最终答案，并在拟合前固定目标特定的空值和阈值。在正确的决策深度（DD）滚动中，当干扰项在最终答案之前被提及时，Qwen3.5-4B在提及下一个内容时解码得分高达0.966（空值0.234），但在最终答案解码时仅为0.221（空值0.186），存在0.696的发射差距[0.648, 0.744]；Llama-3.1-8B得分为0.575[0.514, 0.632]。这种模式并非普遍存在。在启用思考的MMLU问题预指定评估中，使用全前缀注意力读取器对Qwen3-8B的每个思考位置进行读取，两个目标均可解码，且最终答案的读取强度远高于提及内容（在467个问题中，第22层的提及减去答案提升为-0.398[-0.459, -0.336]）。模型、任务、位置和读取器在这两种设置中共同变化，在DD上的匹配比较因即将提及的探针训练不可靠而未产生有效统计结果，因此我们未能确定是什么逆转了顺序。在DD中，植入信号控制显示读取器仅能恢复注入的最终答案信号十分之一的强度。因此，回答候选的可解码性是目标相对和协议依赖的：强烈的回答读取并不单独证明模型何时做出决定，而训练失败的探针并非信息缺失的证据。ECDP是一种实用的控制方法，用于区分即将文本发射与已决决策的证据。

articles.title: A Large-Scale Dataset for Cross-Lingual Multi-Jurisdiction Patent Drafting from Patent Cooperation Treaty Applications
articles.abstract: Securing patent protection across countries requires drafting claims separately for each national patent office, in the relevant language and according to its legal and stylistic conventions. Patent claims can therefore differ across languages and jurisdictions because of translation, target-office drafting practices, and prosecution-stage changes. We formulate cross-lingual patent drafting as generating plausible candidate claim sets for a specified target language, jurisdiction, and prosecution stage from a source claim set in another language. The task models jurisdiction- and stage-specific transformations beyond content-preserving translation. We construct a large-scale Japanese-English dataset by linking Japan Patent Office (JPO) and United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) records through 884,179 Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)-derived patent families. Across six released configurations, these families yield 4,067,168 directional claim-set instances; four core configurations form the main benchmark. Commercial machine translation and zero- and few-shot prompting capture part of the task, while supervised adaptation provides the strongest overall baseline, showing that task-specific patterns can be learned from linked cross-jurisdictional claim sets.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Accepted to INLG 2026
articles.titleCn: 一份基于专利合作条约申请的跨语言多司法管辖专利起草的大规模数据集
articles.abstractCn: 在各国获得专利保护需要为每个国家专利局分别起草权利要求书，使用相关语言，并遵循其法律和风格惯例。因此，由于翻译、目标局起草实践以及审查阶段的变化，专利权利要求在不同语言和司法管辖区之间可能存在差异。我们将跨语言专利起草定义为从一种语言的源权利要求集生成指定目标语言、司法管辖区和审查阶段下合理的候选权利要求集。这项任务模拟了超出内容保留翻译的、针对司法管辖区和阶段的具体转换。我们通过连接日本专利局（JPO）和美国专利商标局（USPTO）记录的884,179个专利合作条约（PCT）衍生的专利家族，构建了一个大规模的日语-英语数据集。在这些家族中，通过六个发布的配置产生了4,067,168个定向权利要求集实例；四个核心配置构成了主要基准。商业机器翻译和零样本及少样本提示捕捉了部分任务，而监督适应提供了最强的整体基线，表明可以从连接的跨司法管辖区权利要求集中学习特定任务的模式。

articles.title: Competing Influence in LLM Populations: Budget Timing and Baseline Drift
articles.abstract: When competing campaigns target a population of large language model (LLM) agents, observed opinion changes may reflect both campaign influence and changes that would occur without intervention. We study how the timing of campaign expenditure and the population's own evolution shape outcomes in a network of persona-conditioned LLM agents that exchange and revise opinions in natural language. A proponent and a challenger are tasked with generating opposing messages under equal delivery budgets, while a separate stance probe measures opinions without influencing the simulation. Across eight claims, we compare single-campaign and competitive conditions against matched no-campaign runs, and evaluate all nine combinations of early, sustained, and late spending on a reference topic. Baseline stance drift varies substantially across claims and, on some, accounts for a sizeable fraction of apparent campaign effects. After accounting for this drift, the direction of observed campaign-associated changes aligns more closely with the claim's epistemic standing than with the campaigner's assigned role. Uninfluenced populations also consistently lose stance diversity, demonstrating that directional opinion change and convergence are distinct phenomena. In networks with two opinion-segregated communities, campaigns primarily reduce differences between communities rather than diversity within them. LLM campaign agents do not always argue for their assigned positions, particularly when these conflict with established evidence. Finally, campaign outcomes depend on the opponent's expenditure schedule: unlike a matched numerical bounded-confidence population receiving interventions at the same times and locations, the LLM population exhibits a payoff structure with no pure-strategy equilibrium.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型群体中的竞争影响：预算时机与基线漂移
articles.abstractCn: 当多个竞选活动针对大型语言模型（LLM）代理群体时，观察到的观点变化可能既反映了竞选活动的影响，也反映了未经干预时可能发生的变化。我们研究了竞选活动支出时机和群体自身演变如何塑造一个由角色条件LLM代理组成的网络中的结果，这些代理以自然语言交换和修正观点。一个支持者和一个挑战者被要求在相同的投放预算下生成对立信息，而一个独立的立场探测则测量观点而不影响模拟。在八项主张中，我们比较了单次竞选和竞争条件与匹配的无竞选运行，并评估了在参考主题上早期、持续和后期支出所有九种组合。基线立场漂移在不同主张中差异很大，在某些主张中，它解释了相当大一部分明显的竞选效应。在考虑了这种漂移后，观察到的与竞选相关的变化方向与主张的认知地位比与竞选者分配的角色更为一致。未受影响的群体也一致地失去了立场多样性，表明方向性观点变化和趋同是不同的现象。在具有两个观点隔离群体的网络中，竞选活动主要减少群体间的差异，而不是群体内的多样性。LLM竞选代理并不总是为其分配的立场进行辩论，尤其是在这些立场与既定证据冲突时。最后，竞选结果取决于对手的支出计划：与在相同时间和地点接受干预的匹配数值有限置信度群体不同，LLM群体表现出没有纯策略均衡的收益结构。

articles.title: A Benchmark and Layered Evaluation Protocol for Evidence-Grounded Shared Belief Updating in Connected Robotics
articles.abstract: Connected physical systems fuse observations from robots, IoT sensors, and edge-AI modules into a shared account of the world, yet most evaluations score only the final answer or action and cannot tell whether a method attributed the evidence, updated its belief, handled contradictions, and justified its decision. We argue that shared reasoning in Connected Robotics should be evaluated as an evidence-to-belief trajectory, and introduce the Connected Robotics Evidence Graph (CREG) Benchmark to make that trajectory measurable. CREG comprises 350 deterministically generated scenarios across seven regimes (justified revision, belief preservation, relation association, contradiction onset and resolution, stale/delayed evidence, and source reliability), each exposing a normative posterior reference at every evidence prefix, validated by an independent log-odds checker and screened by a blinded expert audit. Nine representation conditions separate relation content from serialization, ordering, and metadata. Evaluating four open-weight instruction models and six transparent fusion baselines yields three findings. First, entity grounding accounts for a substantial part of the weak-model deficit. Second, deleting semantic relations costs 15.3 points of strict belief-state accuracy on relation-dependent scenarios (Holm-corrected p<0.001), but an information-matched structured list outperforms the full graph and shuffling the graph does not hurt: relation content matters where required, while graph serialization confers no consistent advantage. Third, belief accuracy is strongly non-monotonic along the evidence sequence, with mid-trajectory failures that endpoint-only evaluation cannot detect. All scenarios, references, prompts, metrics, and analysis code are released for offline, hardware-free reproduction.
articles.comment: 15 pages (10 main + 5 supplementary), 6 figures, 4 tables; supplement adds 1 figure and 7 tables. Project page: https://creg-bench.github.io
articles.titleCn: 一个用于连接机器人领域证据支持共享信念更新的基准和分层评估协议
articles.abstractCn: 连接物理系统将机器人、物联网传感器和边缘人工智能模块的观测数据融合成对世界的共同描述，然而大多数评估仅针对最终答案或行动进行评分，无法判断方法是否归因了证据、更新了信念、处理了矛盾以及为其决策提供了合理性。我们主张，在连接机器人领域，共享推理应作为证据到信念的轨迹进行评估，并引入连接机器人证据图（CREG）基准来使该轨迹可衡量。CREG包含350个在七个规则下（合理修正、信念保持、关系关联、矛盾产生与解决、陈旧/延迟证据、来源可靠性）确定生成的场景，每个场景在每个证据前缀都暴露一个规范的后验参考，并由独立的对数优势检查器验证，并通过盲法专家审核筛选。九种表示条件将关系内容与序列化、排序和元数据分离。评估四种开放权重指令模型和六种透明融合基线得出三个发现。首先，实体定位解释了弱模型缺陷的大部分原因。其次，删除语义关系在依赖关系的场景上导致严格信念状态精度损失15.3分（Holm校正p<0.001），但信息匹配的结构化列表表现优于完整图，而打乱图顺序并无损害：关系内容在需要时至关重要，而图序列化并未带来持续优势。第三，信念精度沿证据序列呈现强非单调性，存在中段轨迹失败，而仅端点评估无法检测。所有场景、参考、提示、指标和分析代码均已发布，支持离线、无硬件的复现。

articles.title: Improving Confidence Estimation in Language Models with Linear Representations of Ambiguity
articles.abstract: As language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed in downstream applications, accurately estimating their likelihood of success on a given example is critical. However, confidence estimates from LMs are poor predictors of their likelihood of success. Accurate confidence estimation is linked in part to the detection of aleatoric uncertainty; we hypothesize that LMs possess representations of at least some aspects of this uncertainty in the form of representations of the inherent ambiguity of the input. Using difference-in-means on minimal pairs of ambiguous and unambiguous sentences, we derive ambiguity representations in LM activations, and find that steering with them selectively (albeit weakly) modulates LMs' judgments of the input's ambiguity. We then propose DART, a fine-tuning method that encourages updates to lie within the span of the ambiguity directions, and penalizes changes to the LM activations outside of this subspace. DART greatly improves calibration, encodes these improvements into the model parameters, and maintains model accuracy on multiple-choice and generative QA tasks.
articles.titleCn: 使用模糊性的线性表示改进语言模型的置信度估计
articles.abstractCn: 随着语言模型（LMs）越来越多地部署到下游应用中，准确评估它们在给定示例上的成功可能性至关重要。然而，语言模型提供的置信度估计并不能准确预测其成功可能性。精确的置信度估计部分与偶然不确定性的检测相关联；我们假设语言模型以输入固有歧义性的表征形式，至少在某些方面拥有这种不确定性的表征。通过对具有歧义性和无歧义性的最小对句进行均值差异分析，我们在语言模型的激活中推导出歧义性表征，并发现使用这些表征进行选择性（尽管较弱）的引导，能够调节语言模型对输入歧义性的判断。然后，我们提出了DART，一种微调方法，该方法鼓励更新落在歧义方向范围内，并惩罚超出该子空间的模型激活变化。DART显著提高了校准效果，将这些改进编码到模型参数中，并保持了模型在选择题和生成式问答任务上的准确性。

articles.title: CaseLaw: A Policy-Decoupled Framework for Training-Free Content Moderation
articles.abstract: Content moderation is inherently policy-dependent: moderation boundaries are often subtle, subjective, and frequently updated, while conventional rule based or fine-tuning based systems require costly rule rewriting, model retraining, or system redeployment. We propose CaseLaw, a policy-decoupled and training-free framework for adaptive content moderation. CaseLaw reformulates moderation as precedent-based retrieval and voting, where multimodal content is transformed into evidence-preserved structured semantics, embedded into a stable semantic space, and classified by thresholded voting over retrieved precedent labels. We train NoteCap on a large-scale corpus of structurally annotated notes to ensure consistent semantic extraction and freeze it during subsequent policy adaptation, which requires no additional training. Policy adaptation is achieved by updating the semantic case library, including case labels and mappings, without retraining models or modifying prompts. To evaluate CaseLaw, we construct MFO-RedNotes, a benchmark for the male-female opposition risk domain. We additionally provide a five category CoPro comparison. Experiments show that CaseLaw consistently outperforms competing baselines in both precision and recall across policy-dependent risk levels and broader safety categories, with category-wise precision/recall reaching up to 86.8%/90.1% on MFO-RedNotes across both policy settings and 94.5%/92.3% on CoPro. Our work highlights the potential of precedent-based reasoning for policy adaptive content moderation and offers a practical direction toward more stable, transparent, and training-free moderation systems.
articles.titleCn: 案例法：一种用于无训练内容审核的政策解耦框架
articles.abstractCn: 内容审核本质上依赖于政策：审核边界通常微妙、主观且经常更新，而传统的基于规则或微调的系统需要昂贵的规则重写、模型重新训练或系统重新部署。我们提出了CaseLaw，一个与政策解耦且无需训练的自适应内容审核框架。CaseLaw将审核重新定义为基于先例的检索和投票，其中多模态内容被转化为保留证据的结构化语义，嵌入到稳定的语义空间中，并通过检索到的先例标签的阈值投票进行分类。我们在大规模的结构化标注笔记语料库上训练NoteCap，以确保一致的语义提取，并在后续的政策适应过程中冻结它，无需额外的训练。政策适应通过更新语义案例库（包括案例标签和映射）来实现，无需重新训练模型或修改提示。为了评估CaseLaw，我们构建了MFO-RedNotes，一个针对男女对立风险领域的基准。此外，我们还提供了五类CoPro的比较。实验表明，CaseLaw在依赖政策的各个风险级别和更广泛的安全类别中，在精确率和召回率方面始终优于竞争基准，在MFO-RedNotes上，跨两种政策设置，类别级别的精确率/召回率最高达到86.8%/90.1%，在CoPro上达到94.5%/92.3%。我们的工作突出了基于先例推理在政策自适应内容审核中的潜力，并为更稳定、透明且无需训练的审核系统提供了实用方向。

articles.title: HiddenPathQA: A Benchmark for Knowledge Graph Question Answering When Questions Hide Their Paths
articles.abstract: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) systems are typically evaluated on questions whose surface tokens lexically expose the gold KG path. Users, however, may ask questions without knowing the underlying schema: "Which condition could Andrew have due to family history?" compresses a 4-hop chain "Andrew --[father]--> parent --[father]--> grandparent --[medical condition]--> disease --[subclass of]--> hereditary disorder" into a single phrase (family history) that names none of those relations. We identify this collapse of path-question alignment as a blind spot in existing KGQA evaluation. Three major LLM-KG paradigms, hop-by-hop exploration, plan-then-retrieve, and similarity-based retrieval, implicitly rely on such lexical cues, an assumption rarely tested in practice. We make three contributions. (i) We introduce HiddenPathQA, a manually verified benchmark of 1,055 questions spanning 2-6 hops and multiple domains, constructed so that question wording does not reveal the gold path's relations. (ii) We propose Holistic Path Selection, which compares questions against candidate relation chains in the local subgraph as complete units, replacing irreversible per-hop relation scoring with globally informed chain-level reasoning. We develop two implementations, TieredHolistic and FlatHolistic. (iii) We conduct a pseudoword stress test that replaces entity names with meaningless placeholders to distinguish KG-grounded reasoning from entity-level memorization. Holistic Path Selection outperforms six strong KGQA baselines (ToG, PoG, FiDeLiS, R2-KG, KAPING, and KARPA) by 8.8-17.9 accuracy points across two LLM backbones and both original and pseudoword settings. Its advantage under pseudoword replacement shows that the gains cannot be explained by entity-level memorization alone.
articles.titleCn: 隐藏路径问答：当问题隐藏其路径时知识图谱问答基准
articles.abstractCn: 知识图谱问答（KGQA）系统通常在表面标记词词汇上暴露出金标准知识图谱路径的问题上进行评估。然而，用户可能在不了解底层模式的情况下提问："Andrew可能由于家族史患上什么疾病？"这个问题将一个4跳链"Andrew --[父亲]--> 父亲 --[父亲]--> 祖父母 --[医疗状况]--> 疾病 --[子类]--> 遗传性疾病"压缩成一个短语（家族史），而这个短语没有提及任何关系。我们识别出这种路径-问题对齐的崩溃是现有KGQA评估中的一个盲点。三种主要的LLM-KG范式——逐跳探索、计划后检索和基于相似性的检索——都隐式依赖于这种词汇线索，而这一假设在实践中很少被检验。我们做出了三个贡献。(i) 我们引入了HiddenPathQA，这是一个包含1055个问题的手动验证基准，涵盖2-6跳和多个领域，其问题措辞不会揭示金标准路径的关系。(ii) 我们提出了整体路径选择，它将问题与局部子图中的候选关系链作为完整单元进行比较，用全局信息指导的链级推理取代了不可逆的逐跳关系评分。我们开发了两种实现：TieredHolistic和FlatHolistic。(iii) 我们进行了一项伪词压力测试，用无意义的占位符替换实体名称，以区分基于知识图谱的推理与实体级别的记忆。整体路径选择在两个LLM主干和原始及伪词设置下，比六个强大的KGQA基线（ToG、PoG、FiDeLiS、R2-KG、KAPING和KARPA）在准确率上高出8.8-17.9个百分点。其在伪词替换下的优势表明，这些收益不能仅用实体级别的记忆来解释。

articles.title: ChemInsight: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating and Diagnosing Chemistry Understanding and Reasoning in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: We introduce ChemInsight, a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) on chemistry tasks that require multi-step reasoning and structured chemical understanding. We propose a two-dimensional scoring system (scope and depth) to assess both task coverage and reasoning completeness. ChemInsight consists of 203 challenging chemistry questions organized into 50 bundles, which support the two-dimensional scoring evaluation scheme. We evaluate ten representative LLMs using ChemInsight and observe consistently low performance across models, with scope scores below 30% and depth scores below 11%, substantially lower than human expert performance. We then proceed to ask (1) What factor limits the advancement of current LLMs in chemistry? (2) To what extent are statistically driven language-model training methods effective at modeling chemistry symbolic language such as SMILES? And (3) Can LLM performance in chemistry be improved through intensive training on large, domain-specific corpora?
articles.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Changyu Hu, Yiming Zou, and Xin Tang contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Zhenduo Zhang, Wang Ren, and Xiao Li
articles.titleCn: ChemInsight：一个用于评估和诊断大型语言模型中化学理解与推理能力的综合基准
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了ChemInsight，这是一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLMs）在需要多步推理和结构化化学理解的化学任务上的基准。我们提出了一种二维评分系统（范围和深度）来评估任务覆盖率和推理完整性。ChemInsight包含203个具有挑战性的化学问题，分为50个包，支持二维评分评估方案。我们使用ChemInsight评估了十个有代表性的LLMs，观察到所有模型的表现始终较低，范围得分低于30%，深度得分低于11%，远低于人类专家的表现。然后我们进一步提出以下问题：(1) 什么因素限制了当前LLMs在化学领域的进步？(2) 统计驱动型语言模型训练方法在建模化学符号语言（如SMILES）方面的有效性程度如何？以及(3) 通过在大型特定领域语料库上进行密集训练，能否提升LLMs在化学领域的表现？

articles.title: BridgeKV: Large-Model Prefill and Small-Model Decoding for LLM Inference via KV Cache Translation
articles.abstract: LLM inference has two phases with different bottlenecks: LLM prefill runs once per request and is compute-intensive. Decoding repeats for every output token and is limited by memory bandwidth. To address the challenges associated with this issue, different solutions have been proposed. All of these solutions use the same model for both prefill and decode phases. We propose BridgeKV, which uses a larger model for prefill and a smaller model of the same family for decoding. A lightweight KV-stitching module translates the larger model's prompt cache into the smaller model's cache layout. It handles differences in cache shape and representation through learned local layer mixing and separate nonlinear maps for keys and values. With both models frozen, we train the module to align their caches and make the smaller model follow the larger model's next-token predictions. A second training stage adds low-rank adapters when further task adaptation is needed. Across six model pairs and five datasets, BridgeKV outperforms fine-tuned small-model baselines with matched trainable parameter budgets in all 30 settings. It closes up to 80% of the quality gap to using the larger model for both phases. On one A40 GPU, Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B to Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B achieves 3.0X faster requests than the larger model alone, with latency close to the smaller model alone. BridgeKV can improve the hardware and system solutions that separate prefill and decode phases across GPUs. A separate serving simulation models request arrivals, queues, and cache transfer. For Llama-3.1-Instruct-70B to Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B, it predicts up to 33.86X faster requests and 27.5X lower energy use than using the larger model for both prefill and decode phases.
articles.titleCn: BridgeKV：基于KV缓存转换的大模型预填充和小模型解码，用于LLM推理
articles.abstractCn: LLM推理包含两个具有不同瓶颈的阶段：LLM预填充每个请求只运行一次，且计算密集型；解码则针对每个输出token重复执行，受内存带宽限制。为应对这一挑战，人们提出了多种解决方案。这些方案在预填充和解码阶段都使用同一模型。我们提出了BridgeKV，该方案在预填充阶段使用较大模型，在解码阶段使用同一系列的较小模型。轻量级的KV拼接模块将较大模型的提示缓存转换为较小模型的缓存布局。它通过学习局部层混合和为键值分别设置非线性映射来处理缓存形状和表示的差异。在冻结两个模型的情况下，我们训练该模块使其缓存对齐，并使较小模型遵循较大模型的下一个token预测。第二阶段训练在需要进一步任务适应时添加低秩适配器。在六个模型对和五个数据集上，BridgeKV在所有30种设置中都优于参数预算匹配的微调小模型基线，其质量差距缩小至使用较大模型进行两个阶段的80%。在一块A40 GPU上，Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B到Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B的请求速度比单独使用较大模型快3.0倍，延迟接近单独使用较小模型。BridgeKV可提升跨GPU分离预填充和解码阶段硬件及系统解决方案的性能。一个独立的推理模拟器模拟请求到达、队列和缓存传输。对于Llama-3.1-Instruct-70B到Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B，该模拟器预测其请求速度比使用较大模型进行预填充和解码快33.86倍，能耗降低27.5倍。

articles.title: Creative Priming: Decoupling Process from Product to Escape the Creative Paradox
articles.abstract: Many of the most consequential advances promised by AI, from curing diseases and inventing new technologies to formulating new scientific theories, are fundamentally creative acts. Yet creativity is uniquely difficult to learn because it faces a creative paradox: learning to repeat past examples of creative success makes those specific examples more likely to recur, inhibiting the very creativity desired. This work argues that creativity is better modeled as an explicit process rather than as a property of individual artifacts, and proposes to learn the underlying generative principles behind the creative process. In particular, to escape the paradox, we introduce creative priming (CP), wherein a trained priming model generates a prompt-specific primer that assists a response model in being creative, explicitly decoupling the creative process from response generation. The priming model learns through GRPO, rewarding primers that lead to responses that are novel, high-quality, and diverse, thereby reinforcing the process that yields creative responses without reinforcing any specific response.
articles.titleCn: 创意启动：将过程与产品分离以摆脱创意悖论
articles.abstractCn: 人工智能承诺的许多最重要进展，从治愈疾病、发明新技术到提出新的科学理论，本质上都是创造性行为。然而，创造力之所以难以学习，是因为它面临一个创造性的悖论：学习重复过去的创造性成功案例，会使这些特定案例更可能重现，从而抑制了所期望的创造力。这项工作认为，创造力最好被建模为一个明确的过程，而不是个体实体的属性，并提出学习创造性过程背后的潜在生成原理。特别是为了摆脱悖论，我们引入了创造性启动（CP），其中训练好的启动模型会生成特定提示的启动器，以帮助响应模型进行创造性，明确地将创造过程与响应生成解耦。启动模型通过GRPO学习，奖励那些能产生新颖、高质量、多样化响应的启动器，从而强化产生创造性响应的过程，而不强化任何特定响应。

articles.title: The Value of Not Knowing: How Fresh Eyes through Naive LLMs Fuel Creativity
articles.abstract: Many major scientific advances come from approaching a problem with a new or novel perspective. While large language models (LLMs) with internet-scale knowledge seem poised to take such perspectives, their consistent generation remains elusive. Instead, models are drawn to dominant views and preexisting, in-field bias. To explore the potential of fresh eyes to increase creativity, this paper proposes naive LLMs, models that are made intentionally ignorant of a specific topic. Through deprivation in training or intentional forgetting, naive models are unburdened by existing dogma, allowing them to be free to make new associations and conjectures. These naive models can then be paired with a stronger mentor model that can refine their unique perspectives into concrete proposals. For the 1B and 7B models tested in this paper, naive models consistently produce seed ideas that are more novel and useful than baseline counterparts, and mentor refinement improves the ideas even further. Thus, contrary to the prevailing tradition of scaling up training data, we demonstrate a case where less information is actually more powerful, in particular when the aim is to discover genuinely outside-the-box solutions.
articles.titleCn: 不知之价值：天真的大语言模型如何激发创造力
articles.abstractCn: 许多重大的科学进步都源于以新颖或独特的视角来解决问题。尽管具有互联网规模知识的巨型语言模型（LLMs）似乎能够采取这样的视角，但它们的一致性生成仍然难以实现。相反，模型倾向于被主流观点和既有的领域偏见所吸引。为了探索新视角增加创造力的潜力，本文提出了朴素LLMs，即有意对特定主题一无所知的模型。通过训练中的剥夺或有意遗忘，朴素模型摆脱了现有教条的重负，使其能够自由地建立新的联系和假设。然后，这些朴素模型可以与一个更强的导师模型配对，该模型可以将它们独特的视角提炼成具体的提案。对于本文测试的1B和7B模型，朴素模型始终产生比基线模型更新颖、更有用的种子想法，而导师的改进进一步提升了这些想法。因此，与扩大训练数据的普遍传统相反，我们证明了在旨在发现真正突破性解决方案时，更少的信息实际上更有力。

articles.title: Explaining and interrupting collective misalignment in language model systems
articles.abstract: In collectives, language model agents can exchange individually innocuous messages that together support a policy violation. Understanding and preventing collective misalignment requires answering the question of which messages sufficiently influenced and necessarily enabled the violation. Collective Dependence Analysis (CDA) operationalises necessity and sufficiency to explain decisions and find the fewest removals interrupting support within tested combinations. Tests covered constructed violations, unscripted agent conversations, and recorded interactions, with selected message removals reducing violations from 93% to 6% in controlled cases. Using O(N) model evaluations for N messages, CDA achieves the same violation reduction with half the deletions of a frontier LLM judge given the transcript and asked for all supporting messages in eligible operational cases. CDA also proposes the mechanism through which the collective misalignment emerged. Nonetheless, complete explanations remain difficult on unfamiliar tasks and some removals can inadvertently disrupt correct decisions. CDA unifies explanations of collective misalignment with experimentally tested interventions.
articles.titleCn: 解释和打断语言模型系统中的集体错位
articles.abstractCn: 在集体中，语言模型代理可以交换各自看似无害的信息，而所有这些信息汇集起来却支持了政策的违规行为。理解和预防集体错位需要回答哪个信息足以影响并必然促成违规的问题。集体依赖分析（CDA）将必要性和充分性操作化，用以解释决策并找出在测试组合中中断支持的少数移除项。测试涵盖了构建的违规行为、非脚本化的代理对话以及记录的交互，在受控情况下，选定的信息移除将违规率从93%降至6%。对于N条信息，CDA使用O(N)模型评估，在符合条件的操作案例中，与被提供文本并要求列出所有支持性信息的边界LLM法官相比，CDA实现了相同的违规减少，但删除数量减半。CDA还提出了集体错位产生的过程机制。尽管如此，在陌生的任务上，完全的解释仍然难以实现，并且某些移除可能会无意中破坏正确的决策。CDA将集体错位的解释与实验测试的干预措施统一起来。
